
## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/1944cb3201a5e729dbc4b0d614dfd355fd01620f) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

name: v1.4.237
body:
## 100,000 stars. Thank you! ⭐🐳

Orca just crossed **100,000 stars on GitHub**! Every bug report, pull request, shared workflow and recommendation has helped us get here. Thank you for building with Orca and helping shape what comes next. ❤️

To celebrate, this release brings a more capable phone experience, more dependable agent conversations, and fixes that keep your work moving across desktops and remote machines.

## The short version

- **More done from your phone:** Create and edit notes, save Markdown on headless hosts, follow relative file links, and see embedded images. Buffered terminal drafts can now survive workspace navigation, too.
- **Chats you can come back to:** Codex chats reopen correctly after undo, Claude keeps its rewound context across Orca rollbacks, and screenshots stay with the conversation. Codex’s skill picker now reflects the skills Codex actually loaded.
- **Your work stays protected:** Discard pauses autosave of the same file across workspaces. Read-only Markdown and CSV views protect your unsaved edits, and new, unstaged Markdown documents open straight into the rich editor.
- **Voice beyond the desktop:** Phone dictation works again through headless `orca serve` hosts, with a CLI command to configure the host’s OpenAI key.
- **Smoother remote work:** Reconnect hidden terminal tabs after a restart, keep browser logins when hosts pair again, and search SSH configurations with thousands of hosts without freezing the interface.
- **Small details, better flow:** Phone tabs follow desktop order, landscape layouts show the session title, keyboard controls keep their height, and worktree safety sweeps skip unchanged workspaces.

**Phone updates:** Updating Orca on the computer serving your phone also updates the phone’s served interface. Persistent terminal drafts additionally require an updated mobile shell.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

- **Native chat (experimental):** Update paired and SSH hosts alongside Orca to get the latest chat fixes. Exact Codex skill-file selection is available on desktop with a supporting host; phone selections and older hosts retain plain-text skill names. Send a skill as a new message for Codex to apply it at the start of a turn.
- **Headless dictation:** Save the OpenAI key on the host doing the transcription with `orca speech openai-key set` (reads the key from stdin). Installed-app `orca serve` hosts on Linux and macOS can also use the bundled on-device recognizer; Windows, managed SSH and WSL servers use cloud models.
- **CLI launch choice:** Explicit `--surface` choices require an updated execution host. Omitting the option keeps your existing defaults.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Pick the skills Codex actually loaded, return to conversations with confidence, and keep your chat history and attachments intact.*

* Use Codex’s own loaded-skill catalog in chat; desktop selections identify the exact skill file, including when names overlap by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30937
* Reopen Codex chats after undo and continue with the correct conversation history by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31041
* Keep Claude’s rewound context intact even after rolling back Orca by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31231
* Show prompts sent mid-turn and `!` commands where Claude actually received them by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31204
* Keep screenshots dragged into a chat available for the lifetime of that chat by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30419
* Retry failed chat names, show naming errors on the tab hover card, and offer **Regenerate name** by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30646
* Keep resumed Claude chats ready to receive messages after settings updates by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30982
* Show **Working** only while Claude, Pi or ACP is handling work, while keeping Claude chat workers running by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30577
* Show sleeping native-chat workspaces as asleep and hide them when the sidebar filter calls for it by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28457
* Tie finished notifications to the correct hook-driven turn by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30620
* Clarify how to continue conversations between chat and terminal agents by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31402

### Phone

*Move between workspaces without losing your draft, work on Markdown without an open desktop window, and enjoy a more consistent interface.*

* Open a worktree on the tab currently shown on desktop by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31215
* List session tabs in the same order as the desktop tab bar by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31269
* Keep unsent buffered terminal commands when leaving and reopening a workspace by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31314
* Create and edit notes on headless hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31291
* Read and save Markdown tabs without an open desktop window, with conflict checks that protect unsaved desktop edits by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31101
* Keep a Markdown save on its original host if the workspace moves while saving by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31376
* Open relative file links from Markdown by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31298
* Display embedded images in Markdown previews by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31304
* Refresh staged files when returning from review by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31295
* Show the session title beside tabs when the phone is in landscape by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30879
* Blend the status-bar area into the workspace header by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31353
* Match the home-indicator area to the terminal input panel by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31354
* Preserve live terminal palettes when the selected theme has not changed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31355
* Keep Claude chats intact after renaming their pane by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31358
* Show the bundled whale icon on DeepSeek Build tabs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31359
* Keep the keyboard accessory row at a stable height when the dismiss button appears by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31363
* Keep dictation controls in sync with the host’s settings by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31349
* Simplify chat by removing the Tools toggle and its open-everything mode by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31188

### Voice & agent launches

*Dictate from your phone through a headless server, and choose chat or terminal for an individual CLI launch.*

* Restore voice dictation on headless `orca serve` hosts, with cloud models on managed SSH, WSL and Windows servers by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31217
* Configure a headless host’s OpenAI dictation key with `orca speech openai-key status`, `set` and `clear` by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31230
* Choose `--surface chat` or `--surface terminal` for `orca agent launch` and agent-backed `orca worktree create` by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31191

### Editor, files & performance

*Protect unsaved work across tabs and workspaces, make new Markdown documents immediately editable, and reduce background activity.*

* Open new, unstaged Markdown files from Source Control in the rich editor by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31399
* Pause autosave across workspaces during Source Control Discard, and prevent read-only Markdown or CSV tabs from overwriting unsaved edits by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31413
* Avoid an unnecessary reload of remote files after each restart by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31196
* Prevent restored-tab disk checks from looping or reporting false conflicts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31250
* Skip unchanged worktrees during background safety sweeps by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31253
* Apply custom tab shortcuts immediately after switching worktrees with the keyboard by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30941

### Terminals, SSH & remote servers

*Reconnect to surviving sessions, handle large SSH configurations, and keep remote updates and browser logins dependable.*

* Start agent terminals at their first real size without the previous 12-frame wait by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30442
* Attach to the successful connection when terminal reconnect attempts overlap by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30448
* Reconnect hidden terminal tabs to sessions that survived a restart by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31254
* Prevent a saved terminal folder on an unavailable network drive from freezing the window by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31381
* Keep mobile terminal snapshots aligned after removing terminal queries by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31348
* Keep the SSH Hosts list responsive and searchable with configurations containing 13,000 hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31405
* Use the same bounded, searchable picker across host lists so large SSH configurations remain usable throughout Orca by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31426
* Preserve in-app browser logins when a WSL or managed SSH host pairs again by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29610
* Replace stale terminal daemons after they drain on Linux and WSL by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31235
* Restart the macOS serve supervisor from the updated app by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31200
* Prepare the macOS supervisor’s code copy in one step by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31303
* Prevent sidebar view settings from blocking SSH host migration by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31374
* Refuse new terminal creation while a server update is stopping the server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29834
* Give Windows process-tree cleanup time to finish rather than leaving grandchildren behind by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29501
* Put sharing first in **Remote Orca Servers** settings by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31335

### History, projects & source control

*Find conversations across machines more easily, and keep project actions tied to the host that owns them.*

* Keep scoped Session History working with very large transcript collections by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30905
* Give history searches through SSH-connected Orca servers the full all-hosts scan budget by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31226
* Include sessions saved under a symlinked workspace’s real path in Workspace history by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31244
* Label the source host when history search results span multiple machines by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31261
* Open PR cards, rows and dialogs on the host that returned the item when projects share a path by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31252
* Keep GitLab items and project dialogs on their owning host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31271
* Save issue-source changes to the selected project row by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31319
* Use the caller’s host for GitHub routing and task filters by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31263
* Separate work-item cache entries by project row and host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31290
* Find registered projects by ID, path and host during refreshes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31274
* Clear repository cache entries without evicting another live host’s project by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31312
* Refuse ambiguous legacy automations instead of guessing which host should run them by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31234
* Reject workspace parents that would create a nesting loop, including before the worktree cache is loaded by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29340
* Fetch PR conflict-preview base branches through the shared fetch controller by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30654

### Tests, builds & maintenance

*Faster release builds, broader platform coverage, dependency checks and continued editor cleanup. The layout-owner work below remains behind disabled build switches and is not enabled in this release.*

* ci(wsl): run the WSL orcad lane on Debian 12 and Fedora 41 too by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29821
* Refactor AGENTS.md for clarity and conciseness by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31238
* test(skills): synchronize Windows rename contention by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31237
* chore: remove CLAUDE.md by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31242
* docs: load Git guidance on demand [skip ci] by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31245
* docs: slim test agent instructions by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31246
* docs: remove redundant max-lines agent instructions [skip ci] by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31247
* ci: stop running WSL host tests for UI-only changes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31243
* Update AGENTS.md with Useful Commands section by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31248
* Editor tab state is written to its buffer record, not copied into it afterwards (phase 1a) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31251
* docs: clarify first-class platform, remote, and mobile priorities by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31265
* test(daemon): run the stalled-reader backpressure test over a Unix socket, not TCP loopback by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31256
* refactor(protocol): each area owns its published runtime capability list by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30641
* Native chat: remove unused journalCheckpoint and setConversationCommand by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30645
* Update AGENTS.md by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31288
* build(cli): typecheck the CLI by following its imports, not a hand list by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30632
* Format AGENTS.md so main's formatting check passes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31294
* refactor(wsl-hosts): add flow in wsl-host-registration; liveness split into state, evidence and monitor by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29506
* docs: add test anti-pattern reference by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31277
* Add the rules that decide which editor tabs are the same file (phase 1b-1, unused) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31272
* Speed up adhoc releases with shared JavaScript and Blacksmith runners by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31297
* Close prompt, Discard, save flush and restart save each decided in one place per buffer record (phase 1b-2, no behaviour change) by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31313
* fix(ci): use one Zod identity in the E2E typecheck by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31320
* Overlap adhoc release gates and cache qualified server templates by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31300
* fix(deps): root and mobile resolve one zod, and CI fails if they drift by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31260
* Overlap native qualification setup with the mobile bundle build by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31336
* Batch macOS code signing for adhoc releases by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31340
* docs(orca-cli): teach agents cross-project parents and re-parenting by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29900
* style: format a test file so main passes the formatting check by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31378
* test(claude): isolate real CLI fixtures and cover chat option requests by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31201
* Carry batched macOS signing and qualified-template caching into production by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31397
* test(vitest): derive the Node SQLite test list from imports by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30647
* ci: one list for Windows boundary tests and one step for ratchets by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30643
* Build adhoc Mac architectures in parallel by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31415
* fix(release): avoid API rate limits waiting for the mobile bundle by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31431

<details>
<summary>Layout groundwork (disabled)</summary>

* Layout-owner build: main answers terminal questions from its own layout (A1, dark) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31187
* A CLI or phone file on a layout-owner server opens in the tab group a paired desktop shows (switch-on builds only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31264
* Layout-owner build: a CLI send, wait or read starts a saved pane that has no terminal yet (dark) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31307
* The window shows tab, title, move and divider changes only from main's update, never drawing them itself (dark, layout-owner build only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31257
* Layout-owner build: phones see main's terminal and editor rows (A2, dark) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31276
* A paired desktop shows the held-terminal banner and Reopen for a server's held terminals (switch-on builds only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31275
* Pin why main's pane list republish waits for a microtask (switch-on builds only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31333
* test(layout): pin the layout-owner save format for downgrade, and keep main's touched-records save with an exhaustive guard (dark, layout-owner build only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31341
* Layout groundwork (switched off): main starts every split and new pane, the window only attaches by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31258
* fix(runtime): a server with no window answers its first terminal create, not 'handle stale' (switch-on builds only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31391
* Layout-owner build: main shows live terminals that lost their tab, at the same moments the window did (dark) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31430

</details>

name: v1.4.235
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

This release makes conversations easier to revisit, keeps more of your agent's work, and cuts background editor activity when you're juggling workspaces.

## The short version

- **Rewind Claude chats:** Use **Rewind to here** on a message that started a turn, edit your prompt, and take the conversation in a new direction. Claude continues from the history you kept.
- **Your chat, your settings:** Each conversation remembers its own model, effort and Fast settings. Switching models keeps compatible choices, and changes to an agent's defaults no longer silently move a chat that has recorded its settings.
- **Keep more of your agent's work:** Completed replies and tool results are saved in full rather than cut off at the preview limit. Use **Show full output** on desktop or phone, or **Show full message** on phone, to load more content from shortened previews.
- **Less waiting, less background work:** New Chat opens the composer immediately, Codex chats get the time they need to start, and the workspace jump palette is preloaded. The editor watches active, recent and at-risk workspaces instead of every workspace with an open tab.
- **A better phone experience:** Live chats reconnect from where they left off, project groups stay in step with desktop, and ready cloud dictation models can be selected from the phone. Workspace creation starts preparing the checkout while you fill in the form.
- **Everyday polish:** Edit images in queued desktop messages, see machine labels only when project names collide, and get more reliable workspace lists, file-conflict handling and remote workflows.

**Phone updates:** Updating Orca on your desktop also updates the app on your connected phone—the phone loads it directly from your desktop.

## Compatibility & upgrade notes

**Native chat (experimental):** Keep paired and SSH hosts updated alongside Orca for the latest chat features. Full-content loading requires host support; content discarded by older versions cannot be recovered. Very large items may still be shortened for display or delivery.

**Cloud dictation:** Select a ready cloud model from the phone's dictation setup or **Settings → Voice**. Configure its API key on the computer serving the phone first.

---

## Product experience

### Native chat (experimental)

*Revisit Claude conversations, keep each chat’s settings consistent, and work with images and long outputs more comfortably.*

* Rewind Claude chats from messages that started a turn, continuing with the conversation you kept by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30400
* Remember model, effort, speed and Fast choices per conversation, including across restarts by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30561
* Save completed replies and tool results in full, with controls to load more from shortened previews by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29982
* Edit images in queued desktop messages: remove, paste, drop or attach by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30815
* Open the New Chat composer immediately while the host gets ready by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29358
* Wait for Codex when opening or resuming a chat instead of failing after 30 seconds by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30395
* Name chats from the first message immediately, even if automatic title generation fails by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30392
* Avoid starting user MCP servers and hooks for background Claude runs by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30939
* Clarify labels for switching agents between terminal and chat by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31134
* Polish the appearance of chat question options by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31219

### Phone

*Keep conversations and project groups current, create workspaces with less waiting, and select cloud dictation models directly from your phone.*

* Reconnect a chat’s live feed from its last received row when the stream ends by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/29007
* Update projects, project groups and workspace rows together so phone grouping stays in sync by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31102
* Prepare the worktree checkout while the new-workspace form is open by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31167
* Select ready cloud dictation models from setup and Settings → Voice by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31221
* Show mobile home statistics when connected to an `orca serve` host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31197
* Keep chat composer controls inside their row by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28983
* Keep session tab icons full size beside long titles by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31169

### Editor, performance & file safety

*Reduce background file watching, speed up workspace navigation, and make reloads and save conflicts more dependable across tabs and devices.*

* Watch active, recent and at-risk workspaces; refresh open files when you return to an unwatched workspace by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30415
* Preload the workspace jump palette before first use by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30935
* Improve save-conflict checks, Undo after reload, autosave during heavy file activity and chat-start error messages by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31216
* Release superseded and closed editor-tab watch probes and disk-check records by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31128
* Avoid reapplying terminal bindings that already match when saving state by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31033

### Workspaces, SSH & remote servers

*Keep workspace lists current, make same-named projects easier to distinguish, and improve remote server transitions and permissions.*

* Show machine labels only when projects have the same name by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31233
* Keep the desktop workspace list current while hidden and include workspaces created on paired servers or other clients by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31090
* Refuse ambiguous same-path project routing instead of following the Active Server selection by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31119
* Allow an older SSH host to move to its managed server while a relay shell identified by its tab remains running by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31093
* Make `orca open-url` on a manually started server ask for a paired desktop rather than an SSH setting by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31120
* Respect the login umask for remote worktrees instead of making them owner-only by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31135
* Improve WSL migration checks for path casing, panes without restore folders and stale agent records by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31211

### Settings & security

*Keep Experimental settings accessible after language updates and tighten permissions for newly created Codex configuration files.*

* Prevent Experimental settings from crashing after language-pack updates by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31202
* Create new Codex `config.toml` files with owner-only permissions by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31228

### Relay service

*Give each relay director revision its own instance limit during rollouts.*

* Use a separate instance maximum per director revision rather than splitting a shared service cap by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31178

### Tests, CI & maintenance

*Expanded compatibility and regression coverage, leaner release builds, and continued terminal-layout groundwork. Layout-owner changes below remain behind a feature switch and are not enabled product features in this release.*

* Layout groundwork (disabled): open CLI- and phone-requested files in the visible tab group by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31123
* Layout groundwork (disabled): surface running terminals without visible panes and determine startup reconnections by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31118
* Test custom terminal titles with older phone layouts by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31127
* Include headless server specs in the manually enabled layout CI run by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31108
* Layout groundwork (disabled): advertise layout-change support to paired desktops by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31131
* Test terminal readiness after a layout-owner server restart loses a pane binding by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31132
* Test file opening from older phone layouts against a layout-owner build by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31138
* Layout groundwork (disabled): use consistent file identities in layout updates by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31140
* Test that windowless host reloads preserve terminals created by main by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31144
* Layout groundwork (disabled): apply individual layout records instead of rebuilding the whole session by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31152
* Layout groundwork (disabled): render paired-server workspaces from the server’s layout stream by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31181
* Format the files changed by the full chat-output update by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31184
* Layout groundwork (disabled): let main create, start and close terminal tabs and panes by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31130
* Update nine end-to-end specs to match intended product behavior by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30897
* Bump the mobile app to 0.0.58 and Android versionCode to 22 by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31194
* Keep Windows daemon teardown tests from counting processes with reused parent IDs by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31192
* Layout groundwork (disabled): restore each terminal pane once at its saved size and identify sleeping or held panes by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31171
* Add checks for host-aware repository routing and migrate existing callers by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31096
* Test that SSH health probes stay responsive while the SSH layer is stuck by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31193
* Update Zod to 4.6.7 for recursive schema type compatibility by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31222
* Test Claude dispatch metadata received after stopping a turn by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31229
* Reduce duplicate release builds and history downloads by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31227

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.233...v1.4.235

name: v1.4.233
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

We shipped two releases today! If you missed it, check out the [v1.4.232 release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases/tag/v1.4.232) too. Highlights include Manual / Auto / Yolo agent permissions, OpenCode 2 in native chat, a better phone composer with file attachments and inline skills, smoother SSH recovery, and a smaller app with faster Mac updates.

**Phone updates:** Updating Orca on your desktop also updates the app on your connected phone—the phone loads it directly from your desktop.

## The short version

- **SSH & remote workspaces:** Connecting to an SSH host works when neither machine can download Node.js, with a one-click mirror Orca remembers and retries. Older Windows hosts (Windows 10 1809 and Server 2019) can run Orca's server, and tunnels recover when a port is held by an old SSH connection.
- **Remote servers in Settings:** Remote Orca Servers is one list instead of six sections, and SSH hosts can be removed in bulk and stay removed. Orca tells you when the same server was saved twice, and adding a server you already saved updates it instead.
- **Phone:** Creating a workspace from the phone is much faster, the workspace list stays in step with the desktop, and session tab icons keep their size beside long titles.
- **Editor:** Orca refuses to save over changes made to a file on disk that you haven't seen, and Reload and Undo behave predictably afterwards.
- **Everyday polish:** Projects with the same name on different machines keep short names and show which machine they're on. Long saved conversations use far less memory when Orca scans them for Session History.

---

## Product experience

### SSH, managed servers & remote

*SSH hosts connect in more situations, Remote Orca Servers is one clear list, and edits always go to the machine that owns the workspace.*

* One-click Node.js mirror when neither machine can download Node by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31069
* Retry with the saved Node.js mirror once a running connect fails the same way by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31089
* Ship node-pty's winpty backend so Windows 1809 / Server 2019 hosts can deploy by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31056
* A managed tunnel whose forward can't start takes the stdio bridge, and reclaims a port an old ControlMaster holds by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31062
* A legacy relay restarted at the same socket never takes over an open tab by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31068
* Detect Linux libraries reliably across SSH and WSL by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31077
* Remote Orca Servers: one list instead of six sections; SSH Hosts: bulk remove that stays removed by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31082
* Adding a server you already saved updates it instead of saving it twice by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31080
* Say which saved servers are the same machine paired twice, and how to fix it by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31100
* Say "Orca on <host>" instead of "managed server" in the UI by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31099
* A moved SSH host lists once in a project's Available Hosts by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31064
* New local projects never dedupe onto an SSH project at the same path by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31055
* PR/MR worktree base refuses SSH projects named only by executionHostId by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31054
* Worktree create sends the host --project/--host selected by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31066
* Editor writes and unqualified removals route by the rows, never the Active Server focus by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31036
* No owner route reads the Active Server focus, so a local row never routes to the focused server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31058
* A damaged browser file list disables only the browser client, not the remote server by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31025
* A live orcad's browser helper pauses for macOS desktop installs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31059

### Phone

*Create workspaces from the phone much faster, and keep the phone's workspace list and session tabs accurate.*

* Prepare the worktree checkout while the new-workspace form is open by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31167
* Phone list resends lost option changes, trusts the feed's row facts, and retries a failed feed read by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31088
* Keep session tab icons full size beside long titles by @AmoabaKelvin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31169

### Workspaces, sidebar & tabs

*Same-named projects on different machines are easy to tell apart, and the sidebar's agent status and visibility settings stay accurate.*

* Keep project names short and show their machine by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/28250
* One agent phase history, so a compaction raises no unread and a title-started turn pushes its finish by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31103
* Visibility settings refresh workspace rows; pre-gap paired-server answers stay unverifiable by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31106

### Editor, files & Markdown

*Saving no longer overwrites changes made on disk behind your back, and previews and renames act on the right file.*

* Refuse saves that would overwrite unnoticed disk changes by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30417
* Disk-checked save follow-ups: repeatable stale reloads, Markdown whitespace, Undo of Reload by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31113
* Markdown preview of a terminal-opened file reads with its source tab's grant by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31060
* A rename retargets only editors whose own owner is the renaming host by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31091

### Browser

*Browser screenshots from an SSH host are checked when they're taken and when they're answered.*

* An SSH host's capture is admitted at each capture and at its answer by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31072

### Performance & reliability

*Long saved conversations no longer take several times their size in memory while Orca indexes them.*

* [mem] Stream saved transcripts and stage large search writes by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/30702

### Relay service

*The hosted relay keeps desktops in their own region and spreads traffic evenly while it is updated.*

* Give region-correction reconnects and roll re-placements the in-region reserve fallback by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31042
* Move director traffic in two steps so a deploy does not land on one instance by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31051
* Let the same-cap trust probe outlast load-balancer warm-up by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31067

### Tests, CI & maintenance

*Faster, lighter builds and checks; the new layout and sidebar work remains behind disabled build switches.*

* Run cell-flags and reserve-watch on the paid runner pool by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31024
* Keep Mac qualification runs out of the release build's concurrency group by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31031
* Build Windows alongside Mac and preserve signing quota by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31032
* Cut end-to-end typecheck memory with Bun by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31046
* Halve CLI compile memory with Bun typechecking by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31043
* Stop the cold-authority scope test depending on the clock by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31098
* Shared switch-on fixtures so 71 layout tests pass with main owning the layout by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31076
* A test-only switch-on server template that packaging refuses by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31097
* No empty extra terminal tab from an old saved terminal record (dark, layout-owner build only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31045
* Agent titles from one status batch reach main as one rename (dark, layout-owner build only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31048
* Main sends one layout update per action, with only what changed (dark, layout-owner build only) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31109
* Same-id workspaces on two hosts sort, nest and stay retained on their own; nested groups and project order hold in host sections (dark switch) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31111
* A read Done no longer hides a pane that is still Working in Smart (dark switch) by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31114
* Update WeChat QR code for group 13 by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/31052

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stablyai/orca/compare/v1.4.232...v1.4.233

name: Orca Mobile Android mobile-android-v0.0.58
body:
Thank you for using Orca mobile! ❤️

## What's new

- With more than one computer connected, tapping Tasks on the home screen asks which computer to open it on.
- Reconnects faster when you switch back to the app.
- If Orca on your computer is too old to serve a screen, the app asks you to update it instead of showing an older version of that screen.

Most phone features come from your desktop, so update Orca on your computer to get everything. See the [desktop release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases) for the full list.

name: Hermes Agent v0.22.3
body:
# Hermes Agent v0.22.3

**Release Date:** October 21, 2026

> Patch release. This tag rolls up the ~620 PRs merged since v0.22.2 into a stable release for the CLI and installer, the Microsoft Store app, Docker and Hermes Cloud. Full curated notes for this window ship with v0.23.0.

<!-- HERMES_BUILDS_TABLE -->

## About this release

Measured at commit `5b147ab036d`, the window since v0.22.2 contains **2,911 non-merge commits** across **4,206 changed files** (+360,278 / −64,308), about **620 merged PRs** and **326 closed issues**.

Also in the window, undocumented here on purpose: MCP progress notifications streamed as live tool progress, a refreshed classic CLI layout (glyph transcript, status line under the composer, two-line header), OAuth clients that plugins declare and Hermes signs in and refreshes, `hermes plugins update` offering every available plugin update plus an Update button for git-installed plugins in Desktop, steering and editing a queued prompt from Desktop, a guided subagent model and provider picker in Desktop, a live `/loop` countdown row in the CLI and TUI, opt-in Telegram DM topic transfer, a `post_compaction` plugin hook, a capabilities catalog, the Microsoft Store build going live automatically when a release publishes, session auto-prune back to opt-in with a one-time prompt when disk runs low, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt and one-slot DFlash drafts in the local runtime, and dozens of new plugin catalog entries.

**Full curated release notes for this window ship with v0.23.0**, which will document everything from v0.22.0 onward — highlights, feature areas, and complete contributor credits. Nothing in this window is skipped.

## Updating

- Microsoft Store app: updates through the Store.
- Desktop app installed from the installer (.exe / .dmg): no change in this release; it updates with the next bundled release.
- CLI: `hermes update`, or re-run the installer one-liner.
- Docker / Hermes Cloud: `nousresearch/hermes-agent:stable` (or `:latest`).

**Full Changelog**: [v0.22.2...v0.22.3](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/compare/v0.22.2...v0.22.3)

name: v0.8.183
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.183

Released on 2026-10-21.

v0.8.182 was tagged but never reached npm (its publish stopped at the package size check), so everything listed for it ships in this release.

Website capture now handles pages that reload after a cookie banner, CLI commands start faster, a repeat `check` starts with the CLI and Chrome already up, and `snapshot` and `check` wait for late images as `render` does. Renders inside a macOS sandbox no longer fail, a sharp sound at a film's start no longer grows louder with each audio pass, and `lambda sites create` takes source files over 5 GB. Cloud renders mix their audio beside the chunks and fail loudly when an audio read is cut off, a 4K camera shown small reaches Chrome near the size it is drawn, a finished `capture` exits even when a site's DNS never answers, and an unreadable frame fails a render instead of shortening it.

## Features

- **AWS Lambda:** A cloud render mixes its audio on its own Lambda while the chunks render, instead of before them, so a long film finishes sooner ([dee8380d2](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/dee8380d2295070353aac1f98deb28c030d86572), [#5997](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5997)).
- **Producer:** A cloud plan can leave its audio out and build that track on its own, which the Lambda change above uses ([8b410f1cb](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8b410f1cb1b0d8e0d433da7fdc7942565c29af2c), [#5988](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5988)).
- **Registry:** New `echo-smear` component: a streak of copies that trails an element as a GSAP timeline moves it faster ([23e7a384b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/23e7a384b623e1c7125f1021e93363fd34f42043), [#5980](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5980)).

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Website capture waits for a page that reloads after its cookie banner closes, so assets and scroll screenshots are no longer empty ([0693839b5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0693839b52306cbe35ee508f7b4c4b6f914a4fae), [#4949](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/4949)).
- **CLI:** `check` prints progress while it makes browser-playable copies of phone videos ([b7fa007bf](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b7fa007bf3cfb03a62bbb5460009c7e628e3bb2d), [#5953](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5953)).
- **CLI:** `check`, `snapshot` and Studio show accented and non-Latin project text correctly instead of garbled ([6d357ff0d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6d357ff0d8dbb88b8d19fe689c15f0808724e52a), [#5843](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5843)).
- **CLI:** `check` no longer calls a film static when it moves only through an SVG mask or clip path, a stroke reveal or a canvas ([0bd626825](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0bd626825c74c9b692b755345eaea93f66dd0577), [#5960](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5960)).
- **CLI:** `check` audits a color-graded video as the video it shows, so the video's layout opt-outs apply and its footage is not read as cut-off text ([9f793a6db](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/9f793a6dbd42a8b31a30087c478a6d7338645f6c), [#5963](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5963)).
- **CLI:** A scoped `keepsMoving` check ignores a changing page background outside its scope ([ba1fa8b12](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ba1fa8b12aefcb9cd94ce2e79b62b0cc0cb79cf5), [#5966](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5966)).
- **Lint:** `check` and `lint` place each scene's audio at its host's start, so scenes that play one after another no longer warn of overlapping audio ([18207de1c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/18207de1c466136c0c5c2524ee1a198e18fd1696), [#6005](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6005)).
- **CLI:** The Chrome the CLI launches exits with it, even when the CLI is killed ([434ad8c41](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/434ad8c41c6fd86b4341c52cc6e751f40474f13f), [#5943](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5943)).
- **CLI:** `snapshot`, `compare` and `check` wait for images that load late, as `render` does, so their frames show what the rendered video shows ([f440db901](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f440db90197b2220f20bd8b97598699209947a17), [#5977](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5977)).
- **CLI:** A finished `capture` exits even when a site's DNS never answers, instead of staying alive until the system lookup gives up ([128973477](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/12897347709bf0213985fb5bc088b29e1de2db80), [#5983](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5983)).
- **CLI:** A first render on a nearly full disk refuses at once with the low-disk message instead of hanging in the browser download, and a browser download refuses up front when its disk has under 512 MB free ([6cb9ce096](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6cb9ce096f80b43b90090ef2bba232211bcc73da), [#6006](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6006)).
- **CLI:** A disk that fills while the browser download unpacks fails the install at once instead of hanging ([84f796549](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/84f7965492ce1753f8ddf367e9720978b33e896c), [#6013](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6013)).
- **Studio Server:** On Windows, two history claims on one project at the same moment no longer crash one of them; the second waits for the lock ([468467003](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/468467003c62d5877f75b080ef8408fb4c963eaa), [#5923](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5923)).
- **Producer:** Renders inside an agent's macOS sandbox no longer fail when reading the system uptime ([26a5ab775](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/26a5ab775b77fde3c2f08839ba34c93f86e7b9da), [#5842](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5842)).
- **Producer:** The disk-space error suggests `--workers 1` only when one worker would stream ([f0ef4cb9d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f0ef4cb9d47986d6cc00fcffc95763e6f19b4c15), [#5934](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5934)).
- **Producer:** A render no longer publishes a shorter or smaller video than it asked for without saying why: an unreadable frame fails the encode, macOS renders keep their frames out of the project folder, and a 4K export of HDR footage is refused before Chrome starts ([8942aa23b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/8942aa23bdaa930468c6931f40341ac14507d191), [#5978](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5978)).
- **Engine:** A sharp sound in a film's first moments no longer grows louder with each audio encode, so audio in renders with sound changes slightly ([87c6e50f5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/87c6e50f5ea9f4c3d2b4d46a071907466e0f8e01), [#5956](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5956)).
- **Engine:** A cloud render whose audio read from a file's link is cut off fails with an error the render retries, instead of shipping the rest of the clip silent ([b4e63cf19](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b4e63cf19f52a0e612e6779feed63454056ffc1c), [#5996](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5996)).
- **Engine:** Renders use the browser the CLI picked when both browser settings are set, and Linux renders on system Chrome no longer take the parallel capture path meant for headless-shell ([0260c40e5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0260c40e568523d53ebd491474b01752001e55b5), [#5987](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5987)).
- **Core:** Audio volume automation stays correct when the browser refuses an overlapping curve ([e44f456b7](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e44f456b7cbf8da6389797f4fb4a776d1ea8885c), [#5927](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5927)).
- **Player:** An embed that sets no height shows its film at the film's shape instead of 0 px tall ([46cb5ca44](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/46cb5ca446c18dbd02e4a618f488d8237bc4482c), [#5932](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5932)).
- **Inspector:** Component reports show the animation code inside large wrappers and only the film's own files ([bbb691001](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/bbb691001dea8767449c9f589720cf86df7cc212), [#5989](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5989)).
- **Inspector:** A component report that runs out of room keeps the code that makes the animations ahead of CSS rules ([41af1add0](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/41af1add0da992dc39542e931e229133438b0466), [#6003](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6003)).
- **Inspector:** A component report spends less of its size budget on fixed text and repeated file names, so more of the film's code fits ([1d422a2fa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/1d422a2fa5b4c00be837379ba60d1a76f1c7ded9), [#6016](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6016)).
- **Inspector:** A component report also shows the composition and host tags that set a matched element's timing ([05315a14b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/05315a14b84992c6794fdf233ac5025d332487d8), [#6015](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6015)).
- **Catalog:** Seven component previews that showed dark text on a black canvas render in their demo's theme, in the Catalog and after `hyperframes add` ([b16d5a706](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b16d5a70635f57c32275b60b0b7afd84173c92fc), [#5995](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5995)).
- **AWS Lambda:** `lambda sites create` and Lambda renders upload source files over 2 GiB and over 5 GB ([c8f322c25](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c8f322c25910ed224e29ca5d1a62a521e62544cc), [#5964](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5964)).
- **Skills:** A storyboard leaves the film as it was until the person says go, so the preview no longer plays the posed stills as a slideshow ([6590d5670](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6590d5670e976ec65c3f972439a15cbe34067f82), [#5982](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5982)).

## Performance

- **CLI:** Commands run without loading esbuild, puppeteer-core or sharp until they need them ([5583ae429](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/5583ae4293c64f21f09de7b820920963b9d51e3c), [#5930](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5930)).
- **CLI:** Commands start sooner by compiling registry schemas on first use ([d898ad89e](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d898ad89eef52e12ebd4fd90f03c1cdb53ba143c), [#5935](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5935)).
- **CLI:** `check` splits its samples over a second Chrome when a core and memory are spare ([952c6ba1c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/952c6ba1c5cdef9411a7daad2b550e63010661c2), [#5896](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5896)).
- **CLI:** A repeat `check` from an agent is served by a check process that already has the CLI loaded and Chrome running ([434ad8c41](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/434ad8c41c6fd86b4341c52cc6e751f40474f13f), [#5943](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5943)).
- **Engine:** Cloud renders take a video's audio from the stretch the edit uses, read from its link, instead of downloading the whole file ([a8a80323f](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a8a80323f69f055bab9f7985b2c3398b9688aecb), [#5972](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5972)).
- **Producer:** Local renders check the audio peak in parallel segments, as cloud plans do ([e319e6449](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e319e644920c64d9c5ba366d607ba89cd4bd2601), [#5942](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5942)).
- **Producer:** Renders the fast capture refuses keep their parallel workers instead of being pinned to one or three ([30f514b13](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/30f514b13a00953ef9e23c64de009a122236d12f), [#5945](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5945)).
- **Producer:** A cloud plan whose mixed audio peaks too high corrects it from the mix itself, in parallel segments, so the plan is faster and the audio closer to the mix ([a125dbc19](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a125dbc19f36a82cc20ebcd54445f9c98d2e3820), [#5981](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5981)).
- **Producer:** Cloud render chunks hand Chrome each video near the size it is drawn, so a 4K camera shown small no longer costs a full 4K frame on every frame ([7cc5dd382](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/7cc5dd382cd068ca3b52102b45f28114711b1eea), [#6001](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6001)).

## Internal

- Four timing tests stop failing on slow Windows runners ([f98ef09be](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/f98ef09be48efdbfda436c269cedbcee9d41d0d2), [#5949](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5949)).
- Studio's real-Chrome tests recover from a stuck Chrome launch or close ([234ebc4ba](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/234ebc4ba1c845a19204c5282c1efb70114248b3), [#5961](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5961)).
- Cloud download tests use small parts so a slow Windows loopback cannot time them out ([852f6f9f6](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/852f6f9f6386fa88b434504233449a9babf995dc), [#5999](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5999)).
- The Chrome orphan test waits for Chrome to exit instead of a fixed 5 s ([00d55a7f1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/00d55a7f1dab0765296793b4da2f3e791b5ce42e), [#5986](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5986)).
- The package size check on every PR now measures what a release publishes, so a release can no longer pass review and then fail to publish on size ([ccc13c3b5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/ccc13c3b5a84f821f61861d6b159ce157ef73e90), [#6017](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6017)).
- The generated catalog is republished ([908f2d095](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/908f2d095bba4e2b97363c5533e2702f1e92505d), [#5540](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5540)).
- Two lint tests that always failed on Windows now pass there ([178eea563](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/178eea5634d4c87ed45c4b8c6b8e38f5b936a98d), [#5579](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5579)).

## Full changelog

name: v18.12.5
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added OpenAI 12-hour prompt caching for GPT-5.6+ on the Responses API: `cacheRetention: "long"` now requests `prompt_cache_options.ttl: "12h"` (instead of the ignored legacy `prompt_cache_retention: "24h"`), and `promptCache.ttl` accepts `"12h"`

### Fixed

- Fixed every OpenAI Codex request failing with HTTP 404 `{"detail":"Not Found"}` on personal ChatGPT accounts whose token is not region-pinned ([#16493](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16493))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Fixed

- Fixed Moonshot `kimi-k3` pricing cache writes at $0; usage cost now includes cache writes at Moonshot's $3/M 5-minute rate ([#16508](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16508))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- `providers.cacheRetention: long` now keeps OpenAI GPT-5.6+ prompt caches for 12 hours (Responses API; cache writes cost 2.5× input instead of 1.25×)

### Fixed

- Fixed subagents spawning at a caller-supplied `effort` (e.g. `hi` → `max`) while `task.enableEffort` is off; the field is now ignored and the agent's configured thinking level (including `:auto`) applies ([#16402](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16402))
- Fixed `omp update --check` failing against JFrog Artifactory registries that add empty `dist-tags` to a tagged manifest; the update check now uses the registry's curated latest version ([#16375](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16375))
- Fixed `<path>:conflicts` on a file past the 10 MiB scan cap reporting no conflicts with no hint: it now names the line the scan stopped at and the ranged `read` that registers the blocks after it ([#16269](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16269))
- Fixed the `ts-set-map` rule stalling tool-call streaming for seconds on a long single-line `Map` literal, and missing `Map` entries written `["key", value] as const` ([#16242](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16242))
- Fixed the `ts-import-type` rule missing inline type imports whose member name is non-ASCII, such as `import("./units").温度` ([#16242](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16242))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Fixed

- Fixed a macOS background action leaving its target in front of your app after you clicked another of your windows, when placing the click took longer than the click itself ([#16217](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16217))


## What's Changed
* fix(update): handled empty Artifactory dist-tags on tagged manifests by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16379
* fix(task): ignored caller effort while task.enableEffort is off by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16406
* fix(catalog): stopped declaring no_constraint codex residency by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16501
* fix(catalog): priced moonshot kimi-k3 cache writes at the 5min rate by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16529


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/compare/v18.12.4...v18.12.5

name: v18.12.4
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Fixed

- Enabled native compaction for supported Bedrock Claude models ([#16343](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16343) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Added

- Added opt-in `reclaimAbovePct` to `auth.accountPolicies`: sessions automatically moved to a lower-priority account return to the preferred one once it has that much quota left ([#14237](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14237) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added `reachesBudgetedHost()`: whether the catalog's host request budgets (inline image bytes, official image count) apply to a request, true on a model's official endpoint and on Factory Droid's own hosts ([#16288](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16288) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added Inception API-key login (`/login inception`) and `INCEPTION_API_KEY` environment authentication ([#16439](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16439) by [@eggpeat](https://github.com/eggpeat))
- Added image support for native OpenAI Decisions and Workers AI judgments, prompted vision chat, and auth-gateway System One requests; images exceeding a judgment API's documented caps (e.g. Clef's 4 images, 4 MiB each) are rejected locally ([#15471](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15471) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy)).
- `isSurvivingAssistant` in `providers/transform-messages`: whether an assistant turn reaches a replay, malformed tool calls dropped first, so callers outside `transformMessages` pick the same latest turn ([#15791](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15791) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

- Reduced native Git diff allocation overhead ([#16349](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16349) by [@kyle-elliott](https://github.com/kyle-elliott))
- Reduced native memory-reranking allocations when candidate text contains repeated words ([#16348](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16348) by [@kyle-elliott](https://github.com/kyle-elliott))
- Reduced allocation overhead when collecting directory grep results, including paginated searches ([#16226](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16226) by [@kyle-elliott](https://github.com/kyle-elliott))
- Token counting for OpenAI, Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM and Jev models is 11-30% faster on English text, code and Markdown ([#16399](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16399) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Fixed `index.d.ts` drifting from the generated bindings, so building the natives no longer leaves the checkout modified ([#16306](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16306) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `cargo test` writing crash reports from panicking Rust tests into your real `~/.omp/logs`: they now go to a per-user `pi-natives-test-logs-<uid>/` under the OS temp dir ([#16386](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16386) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the bash tool's `rm -rf` reporting `No such file or directory` for entries another process removed first and leaving the parent directories behind; under `-f` an entry already gone now counts as removed, as in GNU rm ([#16433](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16433) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the bash tool's `rg -c` and `rg --count-matches` printing `path:0` for every file without a match; zero counts are now printed only with `--include-zero`, as in ripgrep ([#16432](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16432) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `ln -s local://… <path>` in the bash tool creating a host symlink that holds the URL text, which nothing can follow; a symlink on the host to a file-backed URL now stores the file it stands for ([#16428](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16428) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS background input leaving the target app in front of yours when it came forward just as you clicked another window of your app; your app comes back with the window you clicked ([#16217](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16217) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed omp sessions on macOS adding a terminal icon to the Dock after the `computer` tool listed displays ([#13455](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13455) by [@VelizarSeleznev](https://github.com/VelizarSeleznev))

## @oh-my-pi/snapcompact

### Fixed

- Fixed snapcompact archive frames for Factory Droid models ignoring Factory's inline-image budget: they are now sized to half of it, like other budgeted hosts ([#16288](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16288) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added `mergeLineRanges` and an optional `BareLineMode` argument to `parseLineRanges` (`"single"` reads a lone bare `N` as that one line) ([#16435](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16435) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Changed

- `selectorLineRanges()` reads a bare `N` compounded with `raw` (`17:raw`, `raw:17`) as the single line `N`; `parseLineRanges()` takes an optional `"single"` mode for the same rule ([#16438](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16438) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Collapsed `wait` cards show one row per finished job (or a single "waiting on N jobs" line) instead of re-printing the whole job tree on every poll; Ctrl+O shows the full tree ([#16486](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16486) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Bash cards show the elapsed time while a command runs, and wall time, timeout and backgrounded job in the bottom border instead of a separate `⟨…⟩` line ([#16486](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16486) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- The terminal `/jobs` sheet shows the selected job's full command ([#16486](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16486) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Grep, glob, find, IRC message, and `proc://`/`agent://`/`cfg://` result rows start at the same column as other tool rows ([#16486](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16486) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Fixed Tern sessions logging `TSP: terminal stopped acknowledging frames` every 5 seconds for as long as the terminal stops acknowledging frames; it now warns once per stall and logs the stall's length when acknowledgements resume ([#16393](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16393) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- `splitPathAndSel` and `splitInternalUrlSel` peel comma line lists that include a tail chunk (`:1-12,-15`) or repeat the colon after a comma (`:1-30,:-30`, also beside `:raw`); `splitPathAndSel(path, { foldListColons: false })` keeps the repeated colon in the path ([#16435](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16435) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Generic tool cards now reveal the complete result when expanded ([#15335](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15335) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Added `footerMeta` to `OutputBlockOptions` and `ToolCardSnapshot` to draw short facts inside a frame's bottom border ([#16486](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16486) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed markdown table rows shattering at narrow widths when a wide glyph sat in a one-cell column; the glyph is now clamped to its column instead of re-wrapping the row ([#16479](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16479) by [@adi-IL](https://github.com/adi-IL)).
- Fixed charts in answers drawing as blank bands, on screen and in scrollback, when iTerm2 drew them in a background tab; inline images now carry an explicit height in rows ([#16471](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16471) by [@galtamam-cmyk](https://github.com/galtamam-cmyk))
- Fixed an inline image (such as a table's chart) disappearing in iTerm2 when new output pushed it past the top of the screen; it now moves to scrollback whole ([#16467](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16467) by [@galtamam-cmyk](https://github.com/galtamam-cmyk))
- Fixed inline images, hyperlinks, notifications and styled underlines staying off in iTerm2 sessions reached over SSH, where the forwarded `LC_TERMINAL` marker was ignored ([#16450](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16450) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Added Eval `mcp_progress` status events, updated in place per call and evictable under the status-event cap, plus `formatMCPProgress()` and `MCPToolDetails.progress` for MCP progress display ([#16431](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16431) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Breaking Changes

- `readTarEntriesFromBuffer()` in `@oh-my-pi/pi-utils/ar/tar` now returns `Promise<ArchiveIndexEntry[]>` instead of `ArchiveIndexEntry[]`; `await` its result ([#16394](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16394) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Added

- Added `maxStreamSize` to `ArchiveLimits` (default 4 GB): the most a large `.tar.gz` or `.tar.zst` may decompress in one pass, so a decompression bomb fails instead of running without bound ([#16394](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16394) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Fixed

- Fixed `bun test` runs writing their logs into your real `~/.omp/logs`: test processes now log to a per-user `omp-test-logs-<uid>/` under the OS temp dir ([#16386](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16386) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed `.tar.gz` and `.tar.zst` archives that decompress past 256 MB failing to list or read with a raw `Cannot create a Buffer larger than …` error; a bare `.gz` or `.zst` that large now names the archive size limit ([#16394](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16394) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed frontmatter repair deleting HTML comments from document bodies and plain markdown; it now strips only leading comments ahead of the opening delimiter, so prompt bodies keep their comments ([#16481](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16481) by [@adi-IL](https://github.com/adi-IL)).
