name: fresh-editor 0.5.4
body:
## 0.5.4

For live updates on Fresh, [follow me on X](https://x.com/TheNoamLewis).

> Most config options below can be changed in the **Settings UI** - run **Open Settings** from the command palette (`Ctrl+P`).

### Features

* **Simple launch by default** - based on your feedback, some defaults are dialed back so launching is simple. Nothing was removed (#3555, #3556, #3568, reported by @zipproth)
    * `fresh FILE` opens just that file, with no restored session, dock or Welcome tab (even if you left the dock open). This makes Fresh a better `$EDITOR` / git `core.editor`; `fresh --simple` does the same without a file
    * With Auto Attach on, a bare `fresh` is `fresh -a` (no name): the one shared background editor (a `fresh -a` that names a remote host, or finds a per-directory daemon already running in its directory, still goes to that one). Typed in a Fresh terminal, with Auto Attach on or off, either one now leaves that editor as it is and says you are already in it, instead of starting a second editor inside the terminal; `fresh --simple`, `fresh -a NAME` and piped input are refused there with an error. The message says how to start a separate editor anyway (`FRESH_SESSION= fresh --simple`)
    * **Orchestrator mode is now Auto Attach** (`auto_attach`): what the setting does is attach a bare `fresh` to the shared background editor, so it is named for that. `orchestrator_mode` in an existing config is still read, and moves to the new name the next time a setting is saved
    * The Orchestrator dock starts closed, for a bare `fresh` too and for existing users whose dock was open at their last quit; open it from View ▸ Orchestrator Dock and it stays open from then on
    * A bare `fresh` opens the directory you typed it in, also when it reattaches to a running daemon, instead of the workspace you used last. The new **Open Last Workspace** setting (`open_last_workspace`, off by default) brings back the old behaviour, with Auto Attach on or off
    * An empty workspace behaves the same for a bare `fresh` as in any launch: a `[No Name]` buffer on a first run, and closing the last tab follows `auto_create_empty_buffer_on_last_buffer_close` and `file_explorer.auto_open_on_last_buffer_close` instead of always leaving a blank pane
    * `fresh DIR` still restores that directory's previous workspace (open files, layout) and shows the Welcome tab; `fresh --restore FILE` does the same for a file launch
    * `fresh DIR` opens the file explorer unless you closed it in that directory yourself; `fresh --simple` (with or without a directory) starts with it closed
    * Startup is faster with many workspaces, which now load on first use
* **Markdown Source / Rendered / Source+Compose modes** - new commands switch a Markdown pane between the raw text and the composed view, and a dual mode shows both side by side in one scroll-synced tab (edit on the source side; closing the tab leaves your file and panes as they were). "Cycle View Mode" steps through all three (#3562, by @PilotLeoYan)
* **Debian testing/unstable package** - each release also attaches a `.debian-testing.deb` built from Debian's own packaged crates (#3519)
* **New config option: close a shell's tab when the shell exits** - with it on, `exit` or Ctrl+D in an integrated terminal closes its tab (and the pane, if it was the only tab). Off by default; enable it in the Settings UI (#3537, by @cychitivav)
* **Middle-click closes a tab** (#3284, #3286, by @CnsMaple)
* **Clickable "Palette: Ctrl+P" status hint** opens the command palette (#3250, #3576, requested by @Korkman, by @peyton-durand)
* **Duplicate Line Above command**, and duplicated lines keep carets and selections on the copy (#3244, by @kimprap)
* **Terminal programs can set your clipboard** - OSC 52 writes from the integrated terminal reach the host clipboard (#3572, #3573, by @mycloa)

### Bug Fixes

* **Unsaved changes carry over between the background daemon and a direct launch** - an edit left unsaved in a bare `fresh` now comes back in `fresh FILE` or with Auto Attach off, and the other way round; each mode used to keep its own recovery store
* **A detached daemon no longer shuts itself down** - it used to exit after an hour with no terminal attached, taking running agents with it; it now runs until you quit it
* **Markdown compose layout with emoji and CJK text** - code-block frames keep their edges and wrapped table cells no longer start with a stray space or break early (#3562)
* **Clear error in mintty / Git Bash** - Fresh now explains it needs a real console instead of failing with `os error 6` (#3547, #3549, reported by @netoffice-zz)
* **git no longer hangs on a detached daemon** - `--wait` against a daemon with nothing attached no longer waits on an invisible editor (#3555)
* **Plugin bundling uses a private temp directory**, closing a local-user file-overwrite risk (#3557)
* **`fresh -a` works in deeply nested directories** - the daemon no longer dies at startup when the directory path is too long for a Unix socket name; such directories get a shortened, hashed socket name, and every other directory keeps the name it had
* **macOS file-descriptor leak** - the daemon no longer runs out of fds after files change in the project root (#3523, #3584, reported by @IconRunner05)
* **Windows fixes**
    * formatters given as absolute paths (`D:\...`) are found again (#3281, #3289, by @CnsMaple)
    * Copy Path no longer pastes `\\?\` prefixed paths (#3296, #3297, by @CnsMaple)
    * removing an Orchestrator worktree no longer fails with "Permission denied" (#3545)
* **Stale syntax colors after commenting a block of lines** (#3551, by @kimprap)
* **Closing a discarded or saved last tab now closes its empty split** (#3552, by @kimprap)
* **Rename works with servers lacking prepareRename**, such as pylsp (#3540, by @cychitivav)
* **Regex replace keeps non-ASCII text** in the replacement intact (#3571, by @neatsorg)
* **Unnamed buffers honor editor settings** such as auto-close and occurrence highlight after restore (#3570, by @neatsorg)
* **A half-open client connection can't stall the daemon** (#3542)
* **Hidden/ignored files are treated consistently** across Quick Open, the explorer and project search (#3368, #3580, by @lixin-wei)
* **Bundled grammars load before bundle plugins** (#3544)
* **Docs clarify `textmate_grammar` only supports `.sublime-syntax`** (#3115, #3583, reported by @sgon00, by @peyton-durand)

### Internals

* Plugin buffer groups can show a file the user has open as an editable panel, with a new `buffer_group_closed` hook (#3560, #3562)
* Virtual text always invalidates the wrap cache (#3311, #3485, by @anodicpassion); CI artifact usage reduced (#3577)

name: Chromium v155.0.8059.39.1 — Stealth Build (Pro)
body:
## CloakBrowser Pro: Stable advances to Chromium 155.0.8059.39.1 (all platforms)

Chromium `155.0.8059.39.1` is now Stable on **Linux** (x64 and ARM64), **Windows** (x64), and **macOS** (Apple Silicon and Intel).

With a valid CloakBrowser key, the wrapper automatically selects the Stable build for your platform. No version pin is required.

### What's new

- **The newest Chromium, 155**, on every platform.
- **Windows and macOS catch up with Linux:** safer proxy handling, the more patient license connection with the `--license-route` flag, and the refined Windows persona.
- **Closer to real Chrome everywhere:** graphics checks, canvas exports, network timing, the reported CPU architecture on ARM hosts, and a few more Windows font names all behave the way real Chrome does on real hardware.
- **DNS that follows your proxy:** with `--fingerprint-transparent-proxy`, sites are resolved with Cloudflare's DNS over HTTPS, sent through your proxy. Use your own with `--fingerprint-transparent-proxy-dns=<url>`, or `local` for the old behavior.
- **Clear license errors everywhere**, a **more stable macOS persona**, **quieter Windows security logs**, and a **smaller Linux download**.

Your profiles, cookies, and seeds are untouched. Only the browser itself is replaced.

### Current wrapper: v0.6.3

Update the wrapper before launching:

```bash
pip install -U cloakbrowser
npm update cloakbrowser
dotnet add package CloakBrowser --version 0.6.3
```

### Roll back if needed

If a workload regresses, pin the previous Stable build for your platform:

```bash
export CLOAKBROWSER_VERSION=154.0.8037.57.2   # Linux
export CLOAKBROWSER_VERSION=154.0.8037.57.1   # Windows, macOS
```

Remove the pin to return to the newest Stable build.

**If you hit a regression, please tell us.** [Open an issue](https://github.com/CloakHQ/CloakBrowser/issues) or email support@cloakbrowser.dev with the site and what you saw. Pinning the old build gets you unblocked; a report gets it fixed for everyone.

### Checksums (SHA-256)

```text
version=155.0.8059.39.1
a345d8420712b4feb1db093c6f75b87b3a712dbe63d5e19ec56cac44683a1a65  cloakbrowser-linux-x64.tar.gz
3f452084485957af8050f575a9347c002d1601cc61d2f2ec18d479d2f6471dff  cloakbrowser-linux-arm64.tar.gz

```

The signed manifest (`SHA256SUMS` and `SHA256SUMS.sig`) is attached. The wrapper verifies its Ed25519 signature and each archive's SHA-256 checksum automatically.

name: Reasonix CLI v1.39.10
body:
> 用 Go 1.26.10 重新构建以修复证书验证的问题，并且 OpenCode Go 连接改用官方文档里的接口地址、支持 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。

**发布渠道：稳定版 · v1.39.10**

[English →](https://reasonix.io/changelog/v1.39.10/?lang=en) · [网页版完整更新日志 →](https://reasonix.io/changelog/v1.39.10/)

## 概览

**Reasonix v1.39.10 — Reasonix 1.39.10**

用 Go 1.26.10 重新构建以修复证书验证的问题，并且 OpenCode Go 连接改用官方文档里的接口地址、支持 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。

发布日期：2026-10-21

**Desktop 3 · CLI 3**

## 桌面端更新

### 重点内容

- **[Desktop · CLI]** **Go 工具链升级到 1.26.10，修复证书验证对不再受信任的中间证书的处理** — Go 1.26.10 修复了标准库 crypto/x509 的证书验证：遇到已知的、不再受信任的中间证书时会报错（GO-2026-6809）。Reasonix 已用它重新构建；升级之后，漏洞扫描没有再报出 Reasonix 可达的漏洞。 ([#14051](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14051) by @esengine)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **OpenCode Go 连接改用官方文档里的接口地址，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 也能正常使用** — OpenCode Go 文档里新的推理接口地址和 deepseek-v4.1-flash 之前没有收录，所以 V4.1 Flash 连接可能丢失 DeepSeek 的思考和工具历史回放，新地址也缺少 Go 的客户端请求头和模型发现。现在都已支持，旧的路径继续可用。已保存的标准 OpenCode Go 连接会一次性更新，保留你选的模型、凭据引用、价格和自定义字段，并给符合条件的连接添加一次 V4.1 Flash（你删掉的模型不会被加回来）；带自定义请求地址或请求体的连接留给你自己检查。 ([#14029](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14029) by @SivanCola)

## CLI 端更新

### 重点内容

- **[Desktop · CLI]** **Go 工具链升级到 1.26.10，修复证书验证对不再受信任的中间证书的处理** — Go 1.26.10 修复了标准库 crypto/x509 的证书验证：遇到已知的、不再受信任的中间证书时会报错（GO-2026-6809）。Reasonix 已用它重新构建；升级之后，漏洞扫描没有再报出 Reasonix 可达的漏洞。 ([#14051](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14051) by @esengine)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **OpenCode Go 连接改用官方文档里的接口地址，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 也能正常使用** — OpenCode Go 文档里新的推理接口地址和 deepseek-v4.1-flash 之前没有收录，所以 V4.1 Flash 连接可能丢失 DeepSeek 的思考和工具历史回放，新地址也缺少 Go 的客户端请求头和模型发现。现在都已支持，旧的路径继续可用。已保存的标准 OpenCode Go 连接会一次性更新，保留你选的模型、凭据引用、价格和自定义字段，并给符合条件的连接添加一次 V4.1 Flash（你删掉的模型不会被加回来）；带自定义请求地址或请求体的连接留给你自己检查。 ([#14029](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14029) by @SivanCola)

## 升级提醒

本版本无需手动迁移。

## 风险提示

- **[Desktop · CLI]** **配置文件的版本号升到 13** — 升级后第一次启动会改写已保存的标准 OpenCode Go 连接，并把配置版本记为 13。改写会保留文件的编码、换行和未知字段；降级再升级之后，你删掉的模型仍然保持删除。 ([#14029](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14029) by @SivanCola)

## 下载与安装

- [官网按平台下载](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop&channel=stable#start)
- [查看完整差异](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/desktop-v1.39.9...desktop-v1.39.10)

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@esengine、@SivanCola

name: Reasonix Studio v2.47.1
body:
本版用 Go 1.26.10 重新构建，修复标准库证书验证对已不再受信任的中间证书的处理，并修好历史搜索读不到会话时误报“没有匹配”和多进程下会话从搜索里消失的问题。

## 修复

- 构建改用 Go 1.26.10，修复标准库证书验证 crypto/x509 对已不再受信任的中间证书的处理（GO-2026-6809）。关联 #14034。
- 会话记录读不出来时，历史搜索不再说「没有匹配」，而是先提示索引不完整，并把该会话标为损坏、稍后自动重试。关联 #14023 by @chuiwenwei。
- 两个进程共用一个历史索引时，另一个进程刚索引的会话不再被误判为「已删除」而从历史搜索里消失；只有确认文件不存在才会被标记缺失。关联 #14024 by @chuiwenwei。
- 侧栏“项目”标题行里的“+”和“更多操作”按钮悬停时现在是同一种高亮。关联 #14041 fixed in #14043 by @lancy69、#14043 by @lancy69。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@chuiwenwei、@lancy69

---

<!-- lang:en -->

This release is rebuilt with Go 1.26.10, which fixes how certificate verification treats intermediate certificates that are no longer trusted, and fixes history search reporting no match for an unreadable transcript or losing a session another process had just indexed.

## Fixed

- builds now use Go 1.26.10, which fixes how crypto/x509 certificate verification treats intermediate certificates that are no longer trusted (GO-2026-6809). Refs #14034.
- when a session's transcript cannot be read, history search no longer claims a miss; it says the index is incomplete, marks that session corrupt, and retries on the next scan. Refs #14023 by @chuiwenwei.
- with two processes sharing one history index, a conversation the other process just indexed is no longer swept as deleted; only a file confirmed gone is marked missing. Refs #14024 by @chuiwenwei.
- The sidebar's Projects header now highlights the "+" and more-actions buttons the same way on hover. Refs #14041 fixed in #14043 by @lancy69, #14043 by @lancy69.

## Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @chuiwenwei, @lancy69

## What's Changed
* fix(studio): unify project header button highlights by @lancy69 in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14043
* fix(history): an unreadable transcript is a corrupt source, not no results by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14023
* fix(history): a scan must confirm absence before it marks a source missing by @chuiwenwei in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14024
* build: use Go 1.26.10 for the crypto/x509 fix (GO-2026-6809) by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14050
* docs(release): studio 2.47.1 notes by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14057


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.47.0...studio-v2.47.1


---

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 `.AppImage`（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 `--appimage-extract-and-run` 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

name: Reasonix Studio v2.47.0
body:
本版新增默认关闭的 Windows 命令沙箱、定时运行、外部文字确认开关，以及工作台里 PDF、CSV 和静态 HTML 的预览（AI 文件交付卡片需在用户配置里主动启用），并修复长会话窗口内存上涨、1.x 会话导入与历史搜索、自定义预设切换过慢等一批问题。

## 新增

- 设置 → 自动化 → 定时运行：查看、预览确认后创建、暂停、续期、删除定时任务，并查看每次运行的结果。关联 #11406。
- Windows 命令沙箱（设置 > 沙箱，默认关）：不能在授权文件夹外创建或改写文件；删除、重命名、读取、联网、ssh-agent/docker 管道不受限。见 #13109。
- 设置的「工具与权限」里有「外部文字」开关，开启后照抄网页或工具结果文字的调用，Auto 和 YOLO 也先问你；默认关。关联 #13111。
- 配置项 permissions.ask_on_external_origin（默认关）：调用逐字复制了网页或工具结果里的文字时，Auto 和 YOLO 也先问你。见 #13111。
- 远程机器现在可以在侧栏里上移、下移（远程项目菜单里的“上移/下移 机器名”），整台机器连同它的项目一起移动。关联 #13958。
- 会话右键菜单有「标为已读」，未读的会话（本机或远端）不用打开就能清掉未读标记。关联 #13962。
- 打开有未读回答的会话时，在新回答开始的位置画一条分隔线；可在设置的外观里关闭。关联 #13962。
- 用户配置 tools.present_files 主动启用 AI 交付卡片；工作台直接预览 Markdown、图片、PDF、CSV/TSV 和静态 HTML。关联 #14031 by @SivanCola。
- 终端的会话选择器（/resume）里按 Ctrl+D 询问、对同一行再按一次 Ctrl+D 才永久删除该会话；当前打开的会话会被拒绝并说明原因。见 #13954。

## 变更

- 会话很长时，折叠或展开左侧会话栏不再逐帧重算整段对话的样式，动画明显更顺。关联 #13936 fixed in #13937。
- Agent 预设编辑器的“添加模块”下拉在名称旁显示工具、技能或命令自己的一行说明，下拉箭头和“添加模块”按钮的间距也调开了。关联 #13964。
- 交付卡片适配宽窄布局，提供文件类型图标、当前预览标记和“更多”操作；聊天及工作台图标增加统一提示。关联 #14031 by @SivanCola。
- 工作台打开 HTML 默认使用不执行脚本的静态预览；本地桌面需点击“交互运行”才能运行页面。关联 #14031 by @SivanCola。

## 修复

- 启动较慢时，等待窗口说明正在等待本地服务就绪，不再让普通重启看起来像首次安装。启动和关闭到托盘的行为不变。关联 #13352。
- 已完成的工具调用的输出不再被拆成逐行页面节点，调用多的长会话里窗口内存不再因此上涨，外观不变。关联 #13899。
- 恢复旧会话时，1.x 桌面端的会话按各自记录的工作目录归到各自项目，不再整库倒进所选项目；没有记录归属的留在原处并列为未导入。见 #13920 fixed in #13921 and #13970。
- 项目里有大量 1.x 旧会话时，每次展开项目都要把它们逐个重放，列表要等几分钟；现在重放一次后记住结果。关联 #13950。
- 用 `!` 直接运行命令时，现在和模型的 bash 工具一样能找到终端里装的工具（读取登录 shell 的 PATH），不再报“command not found”。关联 #13956。
- 侧栏里运行中的会话行，行首不再出现“圆点叠在竖线上”的两个重叠形状，标题也不再比其他行多缩进一格。关联 #13960 fixed in #13963。
- 会话列表比窗格晚加载时，正在前台的会话仍显示未读圆点，现在窗口有焦点时会自动标为已看。关联 #13962。
- 写入落在「额外可写入范围」等工作区之外的文件时，不再占住整个工作区，别的会话写项目文件不会被卡住；只有同一路径的写入互相等待。关联 #13965。
- 连接 WSL 后，含空格的 IPv6 区域名被写进已知主机文件，之后所有远程连接都读不了它；现在不再写区域名，并跳过已损坏的行、给出警告。关联 #13967 fixed in #13992。
- 在不属于任何版本库的文件夹里，只改文档的交付任务不再被要求补一次根本跑不通的检查，也不再每轮重复同一条验证提示。关联 #13971 fixed in #13983。
- 侧栏里当前会话的行与悬停行、普通行几乎分不出来，现在选中行有更深的底色和一圈细轮廓，悬停不会盖掉它。关联 #13972 fixed in #13975。
- 输入框下方的 Git 指示和相邻的 Agent、询问等控件字号、行高一致，放大界面文字后也不再错位。关联 #13982 fixed in #14000 by @lancy69。
- Studio 计算机操作功能首次启动或中断后重启时，会等待驱动就绪，避免偶发启动失败。关联 #13985 by @SivanCola。
- 服务器拒绝 sftp（如群晖 NAS）时，远程目录选择、连接和 `remote test` 改用普通命令通道；见 #13981、#13987。
- Agent 预设提示「组合所需资源不可用」时，现在会写明是哪个模块（如 tools:xxx）以及原因，不再只显示一句笼统的话。关联 #13988。
- 点过聊天里的文件链接并关掉那个文件后，再点侧栏「文件」会重新打开它，而不是显示文件树。关联 #13993。
- 会话历史搜索只索引「用户说过的话」，不再把宿主前置的语言、日期、项目说明等块写进索引，因此这些块里的词不会再出现「命中却看不到出处」。关联 #14022 by @chuiwenwei。
- 文档删除或撤销访问后不再保留过期的已保存正文；未保存编辑仍会保留，元数据检查不再随每次按键重复触发。关联 #14031 by @SivanCola。
- 新建自定义预设会话按需加载技能和扩展、连接 MCP，不再生成全量快照。继承模式跟随当前已授权配置。关联 #13988。

## 升级须知

- 升级后首次启动会重建一次历史索引。关联 #14022 by @chuiwenwei。
- 已有快照会话保持原行为。新会话使用事件 schema 5、归档 version 3，旧客户端不能继续执行；升级后仍可读取旧会话。关联 #13988。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola、@lancy69、@chuiwenwei

---

<!-- lang:en -->

This release adds an opt-in Windows command sandbox, scheduled runs, an external-text confirmation switch and workbench previews for PDF, CSV and static HTML, and fixes window memory growth in long sessions, 1.x session import and history search.

## New

- Settings, Automation, Scheduled runs: list, create after a confirmed preview, pause, renew and delete scheduled tasks, and read each run's result. Refs #11406.
- a Windows command sandbox (Settings > Sandbox, off): no creating or overwriting files outside granted folders; delete, rename, read, network, ssh-agent/docker pipes are not bounded. #13109
- Settings > Tools has an "Outside text" switch: when on, a call that copies text from a web page or tool result asks first, even in Auto and YOLO. Off by default. Refs #13111.
- permissions.ask_on_external_origin (off by default): Auto and YOLO ask first when a call copies text verbatim from a web page or tool result. See #13111.
- Remote machines can now be moved up and down in the sidebar (the remote project menu's "Move <machine> up/down"), taking their projects with them. Refs #13958.
- the session context menu has "Mark as read", which clears the unread mark of a local or remote conversation without opening it. Refs #13962.
- opening a session with unread answers draws a line where they begin; it can be turned off in Settings, Appearance. Refs #13962.
- user-only tools.present_files opts into AI delivery cards; the workbench previews Markdown, images, PDF, CSV/TSV and static HTML. Refs #14031 by @SivanCola.
- In the terminal's session picker (/resume), Ctrl+D asks and a second Ctrl+D on the same row erases that conversation for good; the open session is refused with the reason. See #13954.

## Changed

- folding or opening the left rail with a long conversation no longer restyles the whole transcript on every frame, so the animation stays smooth. Refs #13936 fixed in #13937.
- the preset editor's add-module menu shows each tool, skill or command's own one-line description, and the arrow and button spacing are less cramped. Refs #13964.
- responsive delivery cards have type icons, current-file markers and More actions; chat and workbench icons share accessible tooltips. Refs #14031 by @SivanCola.
- HTML opens as a script-free static preview by default; on desktop, select Interactive run to execute the page. Refs #14031 by @SivanCola.

## Fixed

- a slow launch says it is waiting for the local service, rather than making an ordinary relaunch look like a first installation. Startup and close-to-tray behaviour are unchanged. Refs #13352.
- a finished tool call's output is no longer split into one page node per line, which inflated window memory in long sessions with many calls; it looks the same. Refs #13899.
- recovering older sessions files each 1.x Desktop conversation under the project its own header records, not all under the one picked; one with none is left and listed. See #13920 fixed in #13921 and #13970.
- a project holding many 1.x conversations replayed each of them on every listing, so the list took minutes; the result is now remembered after the first replay. Refs #13950.
- Commands run with `!` now find the tools your terminal finds (the login shell's PATH), like the model's bash tool, instead of "command not found". Refs #13956.
- a running session row in the sidebar no longer draws a status dot on top of its state bar, and its title no longer sits one step further right than the other rows. Refs #13960 fixed in #13963.
- a session already in front kept its unread dot when the session list arrived after the pane; it is now marked seen as soon as the window has focus. Refs #13962.
- writing a file outside the workspace, such as in an extra writable folder, no longer claims the whole workspace; only writes to the same path wait on each other. Refs #13965.
- an IPv6 zone with spaces was written to the managed known_hosts file and broke later remote connections; zones are no longer written, broken lines are skipped with a warning. Refs #13967 fixed in #13992.
- a Delivery task that only edits documents outside any repository is no longer asked for a check that cannot run there, and a verification debt is explained once. Refs #13971 fixed in #13983.
- the current session's sidebar row was hard to tell from a hovered or plain row; it now has a stronger fill and a thin outline that hovering does not override. Refs #13972 fixed in #13975.
- the composer's Git indicator now shares its neighbours' font and line height, so it stays level with them at larger interface text. Refs #13982 fixed in #14000 by @lancy69.
- Studio computer use waits for driver readiness on initial launch and restart after interruption, preventing intermittent startup failures. Refs #13985 by @SivanCola.
- when a server refuses sftp (e.g. a Synology NAS), the remote folder picker, connect and `remote test` now use the plain command channel. #13981, #13987
- when an Agent preset reports that its required resources are unavailable, the message now names the module (such as tools:xxx) and the reason instead of a generic sentence. Refs #13988.
- after opening a file from a link in the conversation and closing it, pressing Files reopened that file instead of showing the file tree. Refs #13993.
- session history search indexes what the user said, not the host-prepended language, date and project blocks, so a hit can no longer come from words its snippet cannot show. Refs #14022 by @chuiwenwei.
- deleted or revoked documents no longer retain stale saved text; unsaved drafts remain intact, and metadata checks no longer restart on every keystroke. Refs #14031 by @SivanCola.
- new custom presets load skills/extensions and connect MCP on demand. Inherited permissions follow current authorized configuration. Refs #13988.

## Upgrade notes

- the history index is rebuilt once on the first launch after upgrading. Refs #14022 by @chuiwenwei.
- existing snapshots remain supported. Live sessions use event schema 5 and archive version 3; older clients cannot execute them. Refs #13988.

## Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @SivanCola, @lancy69, @chuiwenwei

name: Reasonix Desktop v1.39.10
body:
> 用 Go 1.26.10 重新构建以修复证书验证的问题，并且 OpenCode Go 连接改用官方文档里的接口地址、支持 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。

**发布渠道：稳定版 · v1.39.10**

[English →](https://reasonix.io/changelog/v1.39.10/?lang=en) · [网页版完整更新日志 →](https://reasonix.io/changelog/v1.39.10/)

## 概览

**Reasonix v1.39.10 — Reasonix 1.39.10**

用 Go 1.26.10 重新构建以修复证书验证的问题，并且 OpenCode Go 连接改用官方文档里的接口地址、支持 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash。

发布日期：2026-10-21

**Desktop 3 · CLI 3**

## 桌面端更新

### 重点内容

- **[Desktop · CLI]** **Go 工具链升级到 1.26.10，修复证书验证对不再受信任的中间证书的处理** — Go 1.26.10 修复了标准库 crypto/x509 的证书验证：遇到已知的、不再受信任的中间证书时会报错（GO-2026-6809）。Reasonix 已用它重新构建；升级之后，漏洞扫描没有再报出 Reasonix 可达的漏洞。 ([#14051](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14051) by @esengine)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **OpenCode Go 连接改用官方文档里的接口地址，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 也能正常使用** — OpenCode Go 文档里新的推理接口地址和 deepseek-v4.1-flash 之前没有收录，所以 V4.1 Flash 连接可能丢失 DeepSeek 的思考和工具历史回放，新地址也缺少 Go 的客户端请求头和模型发现。现在都已支持，旧的路径继续可用。已保存的标准 OpenCode Go 连接会一次性更新，保留你选的模型、凭据引用、价格和自定义字段，并给符合条件的连接添加一次 V4.1 Flash（你删掉的模型不会被加回来）；带自定义请求地址或请求体的连接留给你自己检查。 ([#14029](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14029) by @SivanCola)

## CLI 端更新

### 重点内容

- **[Desktop · CLI]** **Go 工具链升级到 1.26.10，修复证书验证对不再受信任的中间证书的处理** — Go 1.26.10 修复了标准库 crypto/x509 的证书验证：遇到已知的、不再受信任的中间证书时会报错（GO-2026-6809）。Reasonix 已用它重新构建；升级之后，漏洞扫描没有再报出 Reasonix 可达的漏洞。 ([#14051](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14051) by @esengine)
- **[Desktop · CLI]** **OpenCode Go 连接改用官方文档里的接口地址，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 也能正常使用** — OpenCode Go 文档里新的推理接口地址和 deepseek-v4.1-flash 之前没有收录，所以 V4.1 Flash 连接可能丢失 DeepSeek 的思考和工具历史回放，新地址也缺少 Go 的客户端请求头和模型发现。现在都已支持，旧的路径继续可用。已保存的标准 OpenCode Go 连接会一次性更新，保留你选的模型、凭据引用、价格和自定义字段，并给符合条件的连接添加一次 V4.1 Flash（你删掉的模型不会被加回来）；带自定义请求地址或请求体的连接留给你自己检查。 ([#14029](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14029) by @SivanCola)

## 升级提醒

本版本无需手动迁移。

## 风险提示

- **[Desktop · CLI]** **配置文件的版本号升到 13** — 升级后第一次启动会改写已保存的标准 OpenCode Go 连接，并把配置版本记为 13。改写会保留文件的编码、换行和未知字段；降级再升级之后，你删掉的模型仍然保持删除。 ([#14029](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14029) by @SivanCola)

## 下载与安装

- [官网按平台下载](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop&channel=stable#start)
- [查看完整差异](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/desktop-v1.39.9...desktop-v1.39.10)

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@esengine、@SivanCola

body:
# oh-my-codex v0.21.28

`0.21.28` is a patch release for JetBrains terminal trackpad scrolling diagnostic (1 commit, 3 files, +167/−0; PR #3873).

## Highlights

- **JetBrains trackpad scrolling diagnostic (#3873):** On macOS WebStorm and other JetBrains IDE terminals, trackpad scrolling is translated to Up/Down arrow keys by the terminal emulator. When alternate screen mode is enabled, this causes the input field to be populated with previous prompts instead of scrolling the output. This release adds a startup diagnostic that detects JetBrains terminal environments and suggests the `omx --no-alt-screen` workaround to users on direct (non-tmux) and hotswap launches. The diagnostic is only emitted if `--no-alt-screen` is not already specified. Detection works by checking `TERM_PROGRAM` and `TERMINAL_EMULATOR` environment variables for JetBrains IDE indicators. Fixes #3872 (reported by @BohdanLavrinenko).

## Compatibility

- The diagnostic is informational only; no behavior changes affect existing workflows.
- No breaking API changes; new diagnostic message is a pure UX improvement.
- Existing sessions remain unaffected.

## Validation

- Pinned candidate `60ae8e90090f41bb52487c13cc3152c1baf05428` passed latest-per-name dev CI: 17 checks succeeded and 8 conditional checks were skipped, with no failures.

name: v0.21.27
body:
# oh-my-codex v0.21.27

`0.21.27` is a patch release for subagents tri-state resume_agent availability (3 commits, 10 files, +317/−30; PRs #3867, #3868).

## Highlights

- **SessionStart reopen guidance for hosts without resume_agent (#3867):** The subagent recovery system now covers hosts that do not support the `resume_agent` tool, providing accurate fallback instructions instead of treating absence as unknown availability. SessionStart recovery guidance now correctly identifies unsupported hosts and recommends appropriate fallback actions.

- **Tri-state resume_agent availability tracking (#3868):** The subagents contract now implements tri-state availability (available / absent / unknown) for the `resume_agent` tool, enabling recovery guidance to distinguish between:
  1. Available: The tool is present and usable for session recovery.
  2. Absent: The host environment does not support the tool; fallback guidance applies.
  3. Unknown: The tool availability has not yet been determined; conservative recovery behavior applies.
  
  This tri-state model is now wired through the native hook contract and the subagents tracker, enabling accurate recovery path selection based on host capabilities. Addresses issue #3866 (reported by ev78394).

## Compatibility

- SessionStart recovery guidance behavior changes for hosts without `resume_agent`; recovery now emits appropriate fallback instructions instead of treating absence as unknown.
- Existing subagent sessions and recovery state remain compatible.
- No breaking API changes; tri-state availability is an internal contract refinement.

## Validation

- Pinned candidate `b58737f0f1eb427b978cb5561672625144616f29` passed latest-per-name dev CI: 17 checks succeeded and 8 conditional checks were skipped, with no failures.
- Release branch CI passed with all required checks green.

body:
> _"You're gonna need a bigger boat." — Brody, 《Jaws》 (1975)_ ## ✨ What's New | Feature | Description | By | | --- | --- | --- | | **Folders on Claude and DeepSeek** _(off by default)_ | Turn on **Claude · Folders** or **DeepSeek · Folders** under Plugins to file chats into folders in the sidebar, as on ChatGPT. | — | | **A quieter, unified look** | The popup, Prompt Manager, export, timeline, highlights, folders and other panels share one calmer style that follows each site's light or dark theme; the Voyager name is drawn as a new wordmark. | — | | **Local Bridge answers ChatGPT's approval card** | When ChatGPT asks to allow Google Drive or another app, [Voyager CLI](https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager-cli)'s `--approve-apps` lets the extension click it for you (CLI 0.4.0 or later). | — | | **Local Bridge saves reply files** | Files a ChatGPT reply offers are saved next to the reply by Voyager CLI (CLI 0.3.0 or later). | — | | **Exact numbers in settings** | Settings with a wide range get a number box beside the slider, so you can type the exact value. | PR #1062 by @ccch1mneyyy | ## 🐛 Bug Fixes | Fix | Description | By | | --- | --- | --- | | **Gemini: exporting very long chats** | A very long conversation no longer fails to export; Voyager exports the loaded part and says only the most recent part is included. | — | | **Gemini: selecting replies to export** | Reply checkboxes show again, no longer cover the first words, and line up in one column. | — | | **Gemini: folders above Notebooks** | After Gemini's sidebar change, folders can again sit above Notebooks or above your chats. | — | | **ChatGPT export button** | The header export button lines up with Share and no longer covers it while a dialog is open. | — | | **ChatGPT Local Bridge** | A failed send takes its prompt back out of the input box, a prompt with a Google Drive link sends normally, and a reply cut short by a dropped connection is no longer saved as the answer. | — | | **Folder details** | The folder arrow no longer turns into a dash, all seven colors fit on one row, sort options wrap in a narrow settings menu, and DeepSeek's select-chats button is no longer covered. | — | | **Prompt Manager after an update** | Updating or reloading the extension no longer leaves the Prompt Manager's button and panel behind on the page. | — | --- ## 中文版 > _「你需要一条更大的船。」——布罗迪，《大白鲨》（1975）_ ## ✨ 新功能 | 功能 | 说明 | 提交者 | | --- | --- | --- | | **Claude 和 DeepSeek 也有文件夹了** _（默认关闭）_ | 在插件里打开 **Claude · 文件夹** 或 **DeepSeek · 文件夹**，就能在侧栏把对话归进文件夹，和 ChatGPT 一样。 | — | | **界面焕新** | 弹窗、提示词管理器、导出、时间线、高亮、文件夹等界面统一成一套更安静的样式，深浅色跟随各个网站；Voyager 的名字也换成了新绘制的字标。 | — | | **本地桥替你点授权卡** | ChatGPT 要用 Google Drive 等应用时会弹出「允许」卡，[Voyager CLI](https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager-cli) 加上 `--approve-apps` 就由插件替你点（需要 CLI 0.4.0 及以上）。 | — | | **本地桥保存回复里的文件** | ChatGPT 回复附带的文件，Voyager CLI 会和回复一起存到本地（需要 CLI 0.3.0 及以上）。 | — | | **设置里精确输入数值** | 范围很大的设置项旁边多了数字输入框，可以直接填准确的数。 | PR #1062 by @ccch1mneyyy | ## 🐛 修复 | 修复 | 说明 | 提交者 | | --- | --- | --- | | **Gemini 超长对话导出** | 很长的对话不再导出失败，会导出已经加载的部分，并提示只包含最近的内容。 | — | | **Gemini 多选导出** | 回复的勾选框重新出现，不再压住正文开头，所有勾选框排成一列。 | — | | **Gemini 文件夹放在 Notebooks 上方** | 侧栏改版后，文件夹又能放到 Notebooks 或对话列表上方了。 | — | | **ChatGPT 导出按钮** | 顶栏的导出按钮和「分享」对齐，打开对话框时也不会挡住「分享」。 | — | | **ChatGPT 本地桥** | 发送失败时会把提示从输入框里取回，不留草稿；带 Google Drive 链接的提示能正常发送；连接中断、没写完的回复不会再当成答案保存。 | — | | **文件夹细节** | 折叠箭头不再变成短横，七种颜色排在一行，窄设置菜单里的排序选项会换行，DeepSeek 的「选择对话」按钮不再被挡住。 | — | | **扩展更新后的提示词管理器** | 扩展更新或重新加载后，页面上不再残留提示词管理器的按钮和面板。 | — | --- **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/voyager-crew/voyager/compare/v2.1.1...v2.2.0 ## 📥 Installation
     

Edge users: Voyager is still maintained on Edge Add-ons for users who need Edge on mobile or tablet. If review is delayed, Chrome Web Store and GitHub manual packages remain available.

- **Chrome / Edge / Chromium browsers**: `voyager-chrome-v2.2.0.zip` - **Firefox**: `voyager-firefox-v2.2.0.xpi` - **Safari**: `voyager-v2.2.0.dmg` > Do not use GitHub's auto-generated **Source code (zip/tar.gz)** archives for manual extension installs. Those files are repository source snapshots, not browser-ready extension packages.
🍎 Safari 安装与升级说明 (Safari installation & upgrade) > 🎉 从 v1.6.0 起，Voyager 的核心功能已正式覆盖 Safari。 > Starting with v1.6.0, Voyager's core experience is officially supported on Safari. - 📦 **安装 (Installation)**: 下载并打开 `voyager-v2.2.0.dmg`，按提示安装应用。 Download and open `voyager-v2.2.0.dmg`, then follow the prompts to install the app. - ⚠️ **旧版升级 (Legacy upgrade)**: 如果仍安装着 `Gemini Voyager.app`，请先完成一次 [Safari 迁移步骤](https://voyager.nagi.fun/guide/safari-migration)，避免两个 App 并存。 If `Gemini Voyager.app` is still installed, follow the one-time [Safari migration guide](https://voyager.nagi.fun/en/guide/safari-migration) first so the two apps do not conflict. - 🖼️ **图片能力 (Images)**: Image Refinement 水印去除、全尺寸图片下载与聊天导出中的图片提取均已支持。 Image Refinement watermark removal, full-size image downloads, and image extraction in conversation exports are supported. - ☁️ **原生云同步 (Native cloud sync)**: Google Drive 与 iCloud 同步均已接入 Safari 原生层。 Google Drive and iCloud sync are integrated through Safari's native layer. - 🔔 **系统通知 (Notifications)**: Gemini 回复完成后可发送 macOS 通知，并直达对应对话。 macOS can notify you when a Gemini response finishes and open the matching conversation. - 🔄 **自动更新 (Automatic updates)**: 完成这次迁移后，后续版本可通过 Sparkle 自动更新。 After this one-time migration, future versions can update automatically through Sparkle.

name: openclaw 2026.10.10-beta.3
body:
## 2026.10.10-beta.3

### Highlights

- Windows reliability: restore fresh state initialization and Gateway startup, hide SQLite helper windows during app updates, and make forced Gateway reinstalls tolerate launcher timestamp settling. (#176194, #174969, #176174, #176945; related #176111, #174906, #176163, and #176872) Thanks @skyzhao1223, @RomneyDa, @easyteacher, @throwingbones, @tjarrau-dev, and @cnnceart.
- Upgrade recovery: converge app-owned plugins to the upgraded core version, restore affected agent stores including held system agents after schema-changing updates, and scope migration rollback backups to the versioned tables being changed. (#174257, #175007, #176783, #172671; related #174120 and #176669) Thanks @RomneyDa, @kazuyuki-eguchi, and @PennyVibe.

### Changes

### Fixes

- Agent state: concurrent initialization can no longer let two agents claim ownership of the same agent database. (#174251)
- Codex and native apps: previews no longer block replies after a context refresh, session replies resume after native child recovery, bound Codex history survives app-server restarts, and native app messages send again after reconnecting. (#177716, #177564, #172705, #171528) Thanks @jjjhenriksen and @RomneyDa.
- Background tasks: completions are no longer dropped when the config changes mid-turn. (#169529; related #169054) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, and @Oldrich333.
- Discord: restore native slash commands in channels and threads. Thanks @montrellcruse and @RomneyDa.
- Agents: keep the prompt cache when a rate-limited run retries, and preserve steering messages that arrive without an explicit target. Thanks @montrellcruse, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.
- Cron/CLI continuity: preserve CLI chat sessions across cron announce wakes instead of resetting their provider session. (#176218; related #176208) Thanks @eliavb43 and @RomneyDa.
- CLI tools: invalidate reused CLI sessions when the available tool catalog changes, restoring tools such as `exec` after Gateway restarts and preventing stale catalogs from reaching spawned agents. (#176577; related #175670) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jackylecalvez2, and @vincentkoc.
- GMI: omit unsupported `reasoning_effort` values on GPT-5.6 tool turns so the provider no longer rejects them with HTTP 400. (#176709) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Windows updates: recognize Scheduled Task permission denials in every Windows display language, keep Windows plugin dependency links across Doctor phases, and clean up backup scratch directories without EPERM failures. (#178624, #178219, #169672, #176836; related #176743) Thanks @RomneyDa, @n572770, @xutongxue233, and @WG-Mojo.
- Update and Doctor: update finalization honors `TMPDIR` for disposable copies, Doctor suggests a retry instead of a restore after snapshot contention, and repeated Docker container restarts no longer take a full Doctor pre-repair capture each time. (#178009, #176779, #173711; related #176750 and #173564) Thanks @RomneyDa, @WG-Mojo, and @8bitsforge.
- Memory: cold Gateway starts no longer open every memory index (restoring 2026.10.4 startup memory), memory files keep indexing after plugin reloads, and plugin reloads no longer time out during slow dreaming cleanup. (#174718, #167756, #169945) Thanks @RomneyDa and @Stronggenetics.
- Nodes: synchronous node exec output is no longer repeated as a separate `Exec finished` wake after the waiting caller already received it. (#164511) Thanks @holgergruenhagen and @obviyus.
- macOS: long exec commands through the macOS app node no longer fail after 20 seconds. (#172117; related #139706) Thanks @holgergruenhagen, @RomneyDa, @ylcn91, and @Colton-Harris.
- Control UI: offer desktop setup instead of Retry when Host Desktop is off, model pickers refresh when the catalog changes mid-read, and locale refresh works again after adding a source-only locale. (#177888, #174812, #172689; related #174368) Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, and @hannesrudolph.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.10-beta.2..bd1a53a3a5f59a8319112250b48d338d74dbaceb history: 53 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 53 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

name: OpenWork v0.18.59
body:
## Read, edit, and discuss documents in Workbot

- **Work on documents without leaving Workbot.** When Documents is enabled for your workspace, preview Drive files before choosing Edit when editing is enabled, keep chat open beside a document, and continue your conversation with the file in view. Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides stay in Google and save to the original; on OpenWork Cloud, Office files can use an editor in your own workspace when enabled.
- **AI models and providers work more smoothly across OpenWork.** Desktop users can use existing Azure Foundry and custom OpenAI-compatible providers on OpenCode v2, see organization model changes in the picker when enabled, and find the same available models in Settings and shortcuts. When AI Gateway access is enabled, cloud agents can use supported models assigned by their organization.
- **Admins can check setup before work gets stuck.** Settings › Diagnostics brings desktop startup, AI provider, connector, and deployment-service checks together. Google Workspace settings can also identify APIs an admin needs to turn on, and Workbot explains when an organization needs an AI provider before it can answer.
- **Chat keeps files, prompts, and agent work on track.** Files saved from chat go to the opened folder, including files created in a conversation's own folder; links with spaces open correctly, failed writes are labeled as failed, and messages in side chats are easier to start. OpenCode v2 history copies can resume after restart; if a chat is too large to copy whole, its largest outputs or attachments stay in the original history.
- **Team and Workbot tasks have clearer paths.** When enabled, members can connect assigned accounts in Workbot; members with team-management access can open the right team's settings, and teams can follow tasks started on another computer. When available, admins can set team or organization defaults for new desktop chats and provider-specific spend limits, and inspect Library use and free Auto conversion insights. Workbot's link-only sharing is gone; authorized invitation emails remain available in Den.
- **Self-hosting and connected tools get practical fixes.** Self-hosters get updated AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure deployment options and clearer service checks. MCP clients can identify OpenWork and receive clearer tool guidance, and the website's Trust Center links now lead to the hosted Trust Center.

Full changelog: https://openworklabs.com/docs/changelog · [Compare](https://github.com/different-ai/openwork/compare/v0.18.58...v0.18.59)

name: v0.2.0
body:
## Highlights

- **GGUF Support.** llama.cpp GGUF files serve directly with `ft serve --model <local file>.gguf`; quantized tensors run on llama.cpp's own kernels (ggml-cuda on the GPU, ggml-cpu for `hybrid` / `cpu` experts). Supported GGUF archs:
  - `qwen2` (Qwen2 / Qwen2.5), `qwen3` and `qwen3moe` (Qwen3 dense and MoE)
  - `qwen35` and `qwen35moe` (Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.6 dense and MoE, Qwen3.8-27B), `qwen4exp` (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next)
  - `gemma4` (Gemma-4 12B, 26B-A4B, 31B)
  - `llama` (Llama 3.x, and Mistral files converted before llama.cpp's `mistral3` arch)
  - `muse-glimmer` (Muse-Glimmer)
  - `minimax-m2` (MiniMax-M2 / M2.x), `minimax-m3` (MiniMax-M3)
  - `glm4moe` (GLM-4.5, GLM-4.5-Air, GLM-4.6, GLM-4.7), `glm5-next` (GLM-5.3-Flash)
- **Support new models.**
  - DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, text and images (#603)
  - Image input for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp (#502)
- **Faster NVFP4 on sm_120 (RTX 50xx, RTX PRO Blackwell).** NVFP4 checkpoints with static activation scales run on NVFP4 activations (W4A4): at 128 or more tokens per expert the MoE layer is 2.54x faster on the RTX PRO 6000 and 3.72x on the RTX 5090 (#736), and Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 and Gemma-4-31B-IT-NVFP4 reach the first token 1.6x to 2.7x faster at 1k to 8k prompt tokens (#737).

## GGUF Support

FreeToken now serves llama.cpp GGUF checkpoints (#690). Quantized tensors keep the ggml type they have in the file and run on llama.cpp's kernels, vendored from llama.cpp 8c2134a8: ggml-cuda MMQ / MMVQ on the GPU, and ggml-cpu row kernels for experts on the CPU (#704). The model config, chat template and stop tokens come from the file's metadata.

- **Weight types** (per tensor; a file preset such as Q4_K_M or UD-Q8_K_XL mixes several):
  - Supported: F32, F16, BF16; Q4_0, Q4_1, Q5_0, Q5_1, Q8_0; Q2_K, Q3_K, Q4_K, Q5_K, Q6_K; IQ1_S, IQ2_XXS, IQ2_XS, IQ2_S, IQ3_XXS, IQ3_S, IQ4_NL, IQ4_XS; MXFP4, NVFP4; Q1_0, Q2_0. The layers of one file may use different types, and an expert layer may pair a float projection with a quantized one (#702).
  - NVFP4 GGUFs converted from ModelOpt checkpoints carry per-tensor `.scale` tensors; the `gemma4`, `llama`, `qwen3`, `qwen3moe`, `qwen35` and `qwen35moe` loaders apply them on dense linears and on every MoE strategy (#732).
  - Not supported yet: IQ1_M (no MMQ kernel); NVFP4 token embeddings; NVFP4 `.scale` tensors in `qwen2`, `qwen4exp`, `muse-glimmer`, `minimax-m2`, `minimax-m3` and `glm4moe` files (refused at load); `--dtype float16` with NVFP4 `.scale` tensors; TQ1_0 and TQ2_0; Q4_0_4_4 / Q4_0_4_8 / Q4_0_8_8, which llama.cpp has removed; types defined only in llama.cpp forks such as ik_llama.cpp; expert layers whose gate and up projections use different types.
- **MoE strategies**: `fused` and `offload` for every type (#690); `hybrid` and `cpu` for every type on x86-64 CPUs, where ggml-cpu picks the best of llama.cpp's x86 CPU builds at startup (#704). Layers of different types get their own slot pools in the expert cache (#689, #700); `cpu` refuses files whose expert layers use several types. `ft bench bw --model <file>.gguf` measures the `hybrid` fetch split for each expert layer kind (#734).
- `scripts/gguf_check/` in the source tree checks whether GGUF files load (config, weights, kernel coverage, chat template) from header-only stubs, without downloading the weights (#756).
- Weights past the 32-bit block offsets of MMQ / MMVQ raise instead of running (#699).
- Not supported yet: image input (mmproj files), Gemma-4 E2B / E4B, the `mistral3` arch, Mixtral, GLM-4.7-Flash (`deepseek2` arch), `glm4moe` files with a fused `attn_qkv`, tensor parallelism.

**Supported architectures**

| Family | GGUF arch | PR |
|---|---|---|
| Qwen2 / Qwen2.5 | `qwen2` | #707 |
| Qwen3 dense, Qwen3 MoE | `qwen3`, `qwen3moe` | #707 |
| Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.6 dense and MoE, Qwen3.8-27B | `qwen35`, `qwen35moe` | #701 |
| Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | `qwen4exp` | #690 |
| Gemma-4 26B-A4B (every ggml type; was Q4_0 only) | `gemma4` | #690 |
| Gemma-4 12B, 31B | `gemma4` | #706 |
| Llama 3.x, Mistral (files converted before llama.cpp's `mistral3` arch) | `llama` | #722 |
| Muse-Glimmer | `muse-glimmer` | #724 |
| MiniMax-M2 / M2.x, MiniMax-M3 | `minimax-m2`, `minimax-m3` | #725 |
| GLM-4.5, GLM-4.5-Air, GLM-4.6, GLM-4.7 | `glm4moe` | #731 |
| GLM-5.3-Flash | `glm5-next` | #721 |

## Model Support

- **Support DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash** (`DeepseekV41ForCausalLM`), text and images (#603)
  - `--swa-decoder-replay bounded|exact`: `bounded` (default) is the tech report's decoder SWA replay, `exact` runs the decoder on every prompt token
  - The two Engram tables stream from the checkpoint shards on demand
  - `reasoning_effort` takes `low` / `high` / `max`; a 1-100 budget goes through `chat_template_kwargs`; DSML tool calls are parsed
- **Image input for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp** (`DeepseekV4ForCausalLM`) (#502)
- Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.6 / Qwen3.8-27B: add the zero-centred norm weights' +1 in fp32 at runtime, as transformers does, instead of folding it into the bf16 weight (#755)
- Qwen3.8-Flash-Next:
  - Serve the model card's 1M-token YaRN recipe through `--hf-overrides` (#573)
  - Reduce QSA block top-k candidates past 16 splits: the per-layer top-k of one decode step at ~985k tokens of context goes from 845 to 45 µs on an RTX 3090 Ti (#571)
  - Load compressed-tensors exports (per-channel fp8 dense layers, NVFP4 experts) and bf16 PLE tables (#759)
  - Fence disk PLE staging against in-flight lookups (#588)
- Keep the Muse-Glimmer attention gate as its own linear next to `qkv_proj` (#741)
- Preserve the GLM-4 router correction bias in fp32 (#469)
- Raise `WeightLoadError` when the checkpoint cannot be read (#518)
- Add `scripts/checkpoint_diagnose/` to the source tree: tells whether FreeToken or the checkpoint is at fault when an HF checkpoint does not load, and fixes a non-standard local checkpoint after showing the plan (#762)

## Quantization

- Keep NVFP4 weight global scales in fp32. They were converted to fp16, where many of them fell in the subnormal range (#739).
- On sm_120 (RTX 50xx, RTX PRO Blackwell), NVFP4 checkpoints with static activation scales (ModelOpt NVFP4, compressed-tensors NVFP4) run on NVFP4 activations (W4A4):
  - MoE prefill from 4 tokens per expert: at 128 or more tokens per expert the MoE layer is 2.54x faster on the RTX PRO 6000 and 3.72x on the RTX 5090 (geomean over 9 model shapes) (#736)
  - Linears: W4A4 prefill and new W4A16 kernels for decode; time to first token at 1k to 8k prompt tokens is 1.6x to 2.7x faster on Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4 and Gemma-4-31B-IT-NVFP4 (#737)
  - `--quant-backend moe.nvfp4=triton` and `linear.nvfp4=triton` keep W4A16

## Engine

- Split the offload expert cache into slot pools: `--moe-cache-scope unified|per-layer`, `--moe-cache-split equal|profile:<path>`, and `--moe-cache-mem` to size the cache in memory (#689)
- Serve models whose MoE layers use different expert formats, one slot pool per format (#700)
- `--moe-strategy fused` serves NVFP4 and MXFP4 experts through the expert banks (#601)
- Serve block-FP8 experts on the `cpu` and `hybrid` strategies (#662)
- `ft bench bw --model <checkpoint>` benches every MoE layer kind of a GGUF or HF checkpoint, and `hybrid` takes its fetch split per layer (#734)
- **Page-locked expert banks**: when pinned memory is capped, `hybrid` with `--moe-cpu-layers` OS-locks the expert banks past the pin limit, and the locked layers keep GPU slots and fetch part of their misses through a pinned staging buffer. This also works for models whose expert layers need several slot pools, such as GGUF files that mix expert types. Adds `--moe-locked-fetch`, `--moe-locked-max-fetch` and `--moe-collect-stats` (#742)
- Spin-wait the CPU MoE pool between layers: +20% batch-1 `hybrid` decode on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 (H100) (#619)
- Split hybrid decode routes inside the ensure kernel (#685)
- Split the CPU MoE executor into weight formats and GPU sync backends (#670)
- Widen the expert gather on NVLink-C2C hosts (GH200 / GB200 / GB300): 222 → 412 GB/s on GH200 (#610)
- Upload CUDA graphs at capture so a stream wait cannot block the first launch (#697)
- Under overlap scheduling, requests now end with `max_tokens` tokens instead of one fewer (#546)
- Preserve greedy sampling in mixed batches (#471)
- Clone inserted radix keys to release request buffers (#559)

## Kernels

- Rewrite the Triton NVFP4 MoE prefill GEMM: 6.6x to 16.1x faster; Gemma-4 26B-A4B NVFP4 prefill with `fused` goes from 5,571 to 35,732 tok/s at 4.6k tokens on H100 (#723)
- Speed up the NVFP4 MoE prefill GEMM on RTX GPUs: a warp-specialized Gluon kernel on sm_120, 1.50x faster per MoE layer at 8192 tokens on the RTX PRO 6000 (geomean over 6 model shapes) (#733); pipelined scale loads on GeForce sm_86 / sm_89 (#735)
- Split Triton decode attention by context length and SM count: batch-1 decode at 128k on H100 goes from 77 to 174 tok/s on Gemma-4 26B-A4B and from 90 to 213 tok/s on gpt-oss-20b (#729)
- Copy Triton attention metadata without blocking the host (#726)
- Rework kernels that Triton 3.8 compiles slower: NVFP4 MoE decode (#631), Triton extend attention and Gemma-4 sliding-window decode (#632), DeepSeek-V4 sparse attention and gated pool (#633), the DeepSeek-V4.1 indexer (#634), and block-FP8 MoE decode and the gpt-oss MXFP4 GEMV (#653)
- Avoid NaN in the Triton sampling softmax when a chunk starts with -inf (#654)
- Correct JIT tensor matcher checks and PDL arch guards (#638)
- Pin the tvm-ffi JIT arch to the bound GPU (#521)

## Server and CLI

- Add `--api-key` authentication to `ft serve`; `ft shell`, `ft ctl`, `ft launch` and `ft daemon` send the key (#639)
- Keep Anthropic inline system messages in place for prefix reuse; `--anthropic-inline-system auto|preserve|fold` (#608)
- Apply `presence_penalty` and `frequency_penalty` (#527)
- Add `--hf-overrides JSON` to override the checkpoint config, with vLLM's semantics (#573)
- Accept `file://localhost/...` URIs for local media (#758)
- Report the backend KV page size in `/v1/stats` (#599)

## AMD ROCm (WIP, experimental)

- Build from source and run on RDNA3 and RDNA4 GPUs; tested on `gfx1100` and `gfx1201` (#132, #587)
- Gate CUDA-only optional backends on ROCm; FlashInfer, `sgl_kernel` and vLLM kernels fall back to the built-in kernels (#134)
- `cpu` and `hybrid` MoE sync with the GPU through HIP stream memory operations (#670)
- Clamp the QSA KV tile to the device LDS budget on RDNA (#587)
- Avoid a Triton 3.8 miscompile of the MoE alignment on ROCm (#691)

## Dependencies

- torch `>=2.14,<2.15` (was `>=2.11,<2.12`), torchvision `>=0.29,<0.30`, Triton `>=3.6,<3.9` (was `==3.6.0`), sglang-kernel `0.4.9` (was `0.4.5`); source builds compile the C++ extensions as C++20 (#630).
- transformers `>=5.18,<5.19` (was `>=5.16,<5.17`) (#698).
- flashlib `0.4.0` (was `0.3.0`) and numpy `<3` (was `<2.5`); numba is no longer installed (#669).
- `[fi]` pins flashinfer-python `0.6.18.post1` (was `>=0.6,<0.7`), and `install.sh` installs flashinfer-python, -cubin and -jit-cache at that one version (#545).
- The `gguf` package is no longer a dependency; gguf-py is vendored (#690).
- sglang-kernel resolves from PyPI; the sglang wheel index is dropped (#524).
- `install.sh` writes `FREETOKEN_HOME` to `environment.d` instead of `FREETOKEN_FT_BIN` (#576).

## Breaking Changes & Deprecations

- **Some FTW checkpoints converted by older builds must be reconverted with `ft checkpoint`:**
  - experts converted with `--moe-backend fused` or `triton` are dense and no longer load; `ft checkpoint` now always writes experts as banks (`--moe-backend` is kept for compatibility) (#601)
  - NVFP4 FTWs that store the global scales as fp16 are refused at load (#739)
  - Muse-Glimmer FTWs with the attention gate fused into `qkvg_proj` no longer load (#741)
  - **Qwen3.5 / Qwen3.6 / Qwen3.8-27B FTWs load without an error but give wrong output**: their norm weights hold the +1 already (#755)
- **`FREETOKEN_API_KEY` in the environment of `ft serve` now turns authentication on** (#639).
- **`ft bench bw` profiles from older builds are ignored**; rerun `ft bench bw`, with `--model <checkpoint>` to cover every layer kind. A layer without a matching row fetches at most 1 expert per step under `hybrid` (#662, #734).
- **`--moe-strategy auto` no longer switches to `hybrid`** from the `ft bench bw` profile; pass `--moe-strategy hybrid` (#734).

## Contributors

@jason-fxz, @zihaomu, @andy-yang-1, @taking-lying-flat, @LZ-QWQ, @YevheniiKotyrlo, @void-mckenzie, @bouclem, @nekomario28, @yunwei37, @xinze-zheng, @SuperHotDogCat, @shubham3-ucb, @ischencheng, @gdevenyi, @ChenyuHeee, @zhangnju, @bettercallcaleb

First contributions this release:

- @zihaomu in #132
- @void-mckenzie in #502
- @YevheniiKotyrlo in #571
- @zhangnju in #587
- @yunwei37 in #599
- @xinze-zheng in #608
- @SuperHotDogCat in #610
- @ischencheng in #654
- @LZ-QWQ in #691
- @bettercallcaleb in #758

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/FlashML-org/FreeToken/compare/v0.1.3...v0.2.0

name: Niubash v1.4.3
body:
# unixwin v1.4.3 发版说明


> 发布形态：niubash **1.4.3**（产品）携带 rubash **1.4.2**（引擎，minor）。
> 引擎包行：如 WinuxCmd #1270 合并并发出 **1.1.19**，本版含 WinuxCmd 1.1.19 引擎包；**已确认**。

1.4.3 是一次修复与收敛为主的发布：解决控制台窗口 gather 卡死，收敛裸盘符行为，加固安装器守卫，并为 gawk LF 契约门禁铺路。建议所有 1.4.2 用户升级。

## 行为修复

- **console-window gather 卡死修复**（rubash#955 / niubash#484）：未闭合的分组内遇到意外的关闭字符（stray close）时，引擎 reader 与产品 REPL 两侧的 gather 正确终止，不再挂死；rubash#955（engine reader 面）与 niubash#484（REPL 面）为同一缺陷的两个修位。
- **裸盘符归一化收敛**（rubash#953）：`D:` 与 `D:/`、`cd D:` 等裸盘符设计ator形态不再各自为政，统一收敛到引擎分发路径——同一输入在不同入口行为一致。
- **encoded-command 别名**（niubash#477）：启动器（launcher）接受 `-EncodedCommand` / `--ec` 拼写，PowerShell 习惯的调用方式原样（verbatim）交接，不再被当作未知参数拒绝。

## 安装与升级

- **installer 守卫加固**（niubash#472）：关闭 #442 守卫的残余绕过面——守卫谓词补全常量折叠、补 `{sys}` 名称边界，探测面更难被构造绕过。
- **gawk CRLF 门**（niubash#479）：发行验证的分段 awk 管道改为对**原始输出字节**把关（LF 契约落地为门禁，niubash#467 的收口）。**前置条件：WinuxCmd#1270**（适配命令以 argv 前缀转发，gawk 退出 text mode）先行合入并随 WinuxCmd 1.1.19 发布，否则该门禁按设计红。

## 引擎与上游

- **bash vendored patch 20**（rubash#957）：vendored third_party/bash 从 Bash-5.3 patch 15 升到 **patch 20**（`9c465866`）。含 16（macOS 动态管道尺寸）、17/18/20（readline 多字节提示词重绘与折行——CJK 场景直接相关）、19（高位字节标识符判定规避）。
- **引擎 1.4.2**：随本版携带的 rubash 1.4.2 为版本递进（metadata），引擎行为面即上述 rubash#955/#953/#957。

## 质量与工程

- **fd/重定向嵌套上下文审计第三轮**（rubash#941）：探针 45 → 56 例，新缺陷 #934 全部面（简单命令/函数/`( )`/复合结构/管道/`$()`/持久 `exec 2>` 等路径的 open 失败归因）以探针钉死并记录，`$0` 拼写归一化使 divergences 信号重新干净——发版基线可回归。
- **clippy batch 2/3**（niubash#476/#485）：niubash-runtime 清空 `cloned_ref_to_slice_refs` 与 `chunks_exact_to_as_chunks` 两批 lint（#450 并行批次），保持零告警基线。

## 发布链

- 引擎钉：rubash re-pin 至 1.4.2 合并提交（`scripts/release/rubash-pin.json`，rubash_rev + rubash_version 同步改）。
- 引擎包：WinuxCmd 1.1.19（v1.1.19 已随本版钉入 `scripts/release/winuxcmd-pin.json`，tag 与双架构 SHA256 已更新）。
- winget：v1.4.3 资产出包后提交新 manifest PR（旧 #444854 已关闭，不在旧 PR 续作）。

---

**完整变更清单**见两仓 CHANGELOG 与各 issue/PR。tag 时点按 1.4.1/1.4.2 惯例把本稿收敛进 niubash CHANGELOG 的 `## [1.4.3] - <发布日>` 小节（rubash 侧无逐版小节惯例，保持 [Unreleased] 现状）。

## What's Changed

* fix(hooks): preserve label text when renaming options without descriptions (#1285) by @Swatantra-66 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1286

* fix(dotnet): match the Python SDK exactly in routing, language, email, rounding and config by @kevin-gatimu in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1291
* feat(rust): add predict_long and match the Python SDK exactly by @kevin-gatimu in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1292
* fix(tools): fail closed on a non-object remote decision response by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1293

* fix(evals): refuse a boolean confidence in _answer_confidence by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1295

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/compare/v0.4.12...v0.4.13

## Release Notes

Released on 2026-10-20.

This release addresses [GHSA-hq85-5cpj-mr62](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/security/advisories/GHSA-hq85-5cpj-mr62), which involves a root CA whose intermediate on the Web PKI have been compromised. Users are encouraged to upgrade immediately, as well as confirm that all other software that uses bundled CAs is also properly updated.

### Preview features

- Validate PEP 825 variant metadata and treat package versions with invalid metadata as unavailable under `wheel-variants` ([#22512](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22512))

### Other changes

- Update the bundled Mozilla root certificates via `webpki-root-certs` 1.0.10 ([#22760](https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/pull/22760))

```sh

```

### Install prebuilt binaries via powershell script

```sh
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -c "irm https://releases.astral.sh/github/uv/releases/download/0.13.4/uv-installer.ps1 | iex"
```

name: v1.3.9
body:
[English](#en-v1.3.9) | [中文](#cn-v1.3.9)

Highlights

- Added official **`mpt` pip packaging**. Start the WebUI with `mpt webui` or generate videos with `mpt cli`. - Added **static and slow zoom image effects** for local and AI-generated images. Slow zoom remains the default. - Added Kimi Code subscription access with browser authorization, alongside improvements to the sign-in dialog, status updates, and cancellation. - Added an optional **local SDXL image server** for the OpenAI-compatible image material workflow, with idle GPU offloading. - Added Opper, onomeo, Muse Spark, and EmpirioLabs AI LLM providers, and completed Brazilian Portuguese WebUI translations. - Added **diagnostic logging controls** in the WebUI, including runtime log-level changes and opt-in API request tracing with redaction and size limits. ## Fixes and Improvements - Fixed grayscale image brightness, transparent image backgrounds, zoom mask alignment, and subtitle background colors. Improved transitions on short clips, background music fade-out, and special-character handling in concatenation paths. - Isolated intermediate image files across concurrent jobs, improved image cache identity, and validated cached downloads. Completed videos are retained when another video in the same batch fails. - Fixed speech speed, volume, and audio container handling across several providers. Improved remote audio validation and preserved existing audio until replacement output is ready. - Improved subtitle timestamp rounding, long-word wrapping, Unicode handling, and pause-tag recognition. Symbol-only lines and separators no longer distort estimated subtitle alignment. - Fixed Chinese and Japanese fallback social titles using the entire script. Improved JSON extraction, reasoning removal, Markdown cleanup, and generated search-term validation. - Expanded supported local upload formats, including multi-picture camera JPEGs. Improved task history checks, deletion state, subtitle previews, and model connection error messages in the WebUI. - Added HEAD support for generated artifacts and improved byte-range downloads, validation errors, and Redis task updates and deletion safeguards. - Reduced unsafe speech resubmissions after lost responses or redirects, preserved Upload-Post tracking handles, and improved WaveSpeed submission error detection. - Updated Edge TTS to address 403 failures, constrained PyAV for Whisper compatibility, and fixed Windows cache cleanup and UTF-8 BOM handling in locale files. - Improved the agent helper's configuration handling and preflight checks, including workflows with prepared narration and visuals that do not need an LLM. ## What's Changed - Official pip package with WebUI and CLI launchers — [c3634de](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/c3634de097ea4951935d22e94580ff0ad2665503). - Static and slow zoom image options — [90f7701](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/90f77011d7e3b46d382e6d0180dabfb6725ffee4). - Kimi Code subscription provider — @ysntony in [#1599](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1599), followed by [sign-in flow improvements](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/4204d0f). - Local SDXL image server — @imkashif in [#1668](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1668). - Opper LLM provider — @Felixkw12 in [#1589](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1589). - onomeo LLM provider — @Owaid0723666 in [#1600](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1600). - Muse Spark provider and Brazilian Portuguese translations — @humbertocortezia in [#1657](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1657). - EmpirioLabs AI provider — @Adam-Dalloul in [#1694](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1694). - Runtime diagnostic logging and request tracing — [6940611](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/6940611cc2791d1ca13b3af7ee893ccd9544b874). - Chinese and Japanese fallback social titles — [e25326e](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/commit/e25326e). - Retained completed videos after batch failures — @hdu-r3drum in [#1597](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1597). - Edge TTS 403 fix — @HEOJUNFO in [#1652](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1652). - Whisper/PyAV compatibility — @cristianchiriac in [#1582](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1582). - Windows cache cleanup — @shan3520 in [#1654](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1654). - UTF-8 BOM locale support — @ketpatil77 in [#1658](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1658). - Task protection for unparseable states — @RerankerGuo in [#1663](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1663). - Clearer model connection errors — @fengqiaoqu in [#1645](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1645). - Local material preflight checks — @drakeo338 in [#1585](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1585); preserved Redis task IDs — @ac1982 in [#1588](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1588). - Grayscale rendering, artifact HEAD requests, and prepared-media agent workflows — @rudycelekli in [#1620](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1620), [#1636](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1636), and [#1608](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/pull/1608), alongside many subtitle, speech, material, API, and task reliability fixes. Thanks to all contributors and everyone who reported issues and helped test these changes! **Full Changelog**: [v1.3.8...v1.3.9](https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo/compare/v1.3.8...v1.3.9) ---

重点更新

- 支持通过 pip 安装官方 **`mpt` 包**，使用 `mpt webui` 启动界面，或通过 `mpt cli` 生成视频。 - 新增**图片动态效果选项**，本地图片和 AI 生成图片均可选择“静止”或“缓慢放大”，默认保留缓慢放大。 - 新增 Kimi Code 订阅接入，支持浏览器授权登录，并优化登录窗口布局、状态更新和取消操作。 - 新增可选的**本地 SDXL 生图服务**，通过 OpenAI 兼容接口接入图片素材生成，支持空闲时释放 GPU 显存。 - 新增 Opper、onomeo、Muse Spark 和 EmpirioLabs AI 大模型服务，完善巴西葡萄牙语界面翻译。 - 新增**诊断日志设置**，支持在 WebUI 中即时调整日志等级，按需记录经过脱敏和长度限制的 API 请求参数。 ## 修复与改进 - 修复灰度图片亮度、透明图片背景、缩放蒙版对齐和字幕背景颜色问题；改善短片段转场、背景音乐淡出和拼接路径中的特殊字符处理。 - 隔离并发任务的图片中间文件，改善图片缓存标识并校验下载缓存；批量生成部分失败时，保留已经完成的视频。 - 修复部分配音服务的语速、音量和音频格式处理，完善远程音频校验；替换音频准备完成前保留已有文件。 - 改善字幕时间戳舍入、长词换行、Unicode 字符和停顿标签识别，避免纯符号行和分隔线干扰字幕时间轴估算。 - 修复中文、日文备用社交标题使用整篇脚本的问题；改善 JSON 提取、推理内容过滤、Markdown 文案清理和素材搜索词校验。 - 补齐支持的本地上传格式，包括多图相机 JPEG；改善 WebUI 历史视频检查、任务删除状态、字幕预览和模型连接错误提示。 - name: v15.0.1 — Consistent Smart recall across merged projects
body:
# Keep Smart recall consistent across merged projects

Smart search, timeline context, and selected observation details now use the same checkout project scope. An observation found through a merged project alias remains available in the next two steps, instead of incorrectly returning “not found.”

- Resolves the same project read keys for search results, explicit timeline anchors, query-selected timeline anchors, and selected observation reads.
- Keeps adopted records visible while excluding unrelated or unadopted records and respecting platform-source filters.
- Preserves the Smart default three-step workflow and the optional `dumb_search` alternative introduced in 15.0.0. No API or schema migration is required.

Regression coverage includes real HTTP/SQLite cases that fail on 15.0.0 and pass with this repair, plus related scope-isolation checks.

name: v15.0.0 — Smart memory search by default
body:
# Smart memory search by default

Memory recall now defaults to Smart: search the compact index, inspect context around relevant results, then fetch only the selected details. The agent reasons about relevance between these three steps. Local, cloud/Pro, and standalone-server instructions describe the tools available in that runtime.

The optional one-call lookup is now `dumb_search`. Its description is explicit: “Doesn’t reason about the results. Fast, but shallow. Use Smart for reliable recall.” It performs deterministic title matching and does not reason about relevance.

## Migration

- Use the `mem-search` skill for default Smart recall. Local tools are `search` → `timeline` → `get_observations`; Cloud/Pro starts with `memory_search` and can fetch selected summaries with `get_summaries`.
- Replace calls to the old `mem_search` guided/auto API and `flash_search` with the Smart workflow, or explicitly choose `dumb_search` for a shallow lookup. Auto/guided modes and continuation cursors are removed.
- Refresh existing MCP connections so clients load the new tool catalog and descriptions.

## Correctness

- Cloud timeline supports context anchored to a selected search result.
- Standalone-server recall stays scoped to its configured server project rather than reading a local worker's memory.
- Selected-detail output reports its bounds honestly and preserves selected record identities when long content must be shortened.
- Native memory lookup uses observation-only indexes, and mixed local indexes retain session/prompt ID prefixes so follow-up reads cannot select a different record kind with the same number.
- Installer prompts, public documentation, integration instructions, and generated memory guidance use the same Smart-first policy.

## Other changes since v14.0.1

- Added Hermes Agent memory support and installation, including safe handling of existing YAML configuration.
- Added fallback between an Anthropic API key and the Claude subscription, with quota classification and recovery back to the primary provider at a message boundary.
- Kept worker HTTP requests responsive during local context reads, bounded broad full-text fallback searches, and removed quadratic tag-stripping stalls.
- Improved memory correctness: `type="all"` searches every category, deleted observations remove their Chroma documents, unexpected Chroma exits reject pending requests, and failed Windows checkpoint renames preserve the previous checkpoint.
- Tightened privacy and request handling: fully private prompts no longer become stored user requests; key redaction handles trailing dashes; internal Grok research briefs do not become user work; multilingual work requests are recognized; and OpenRouter field condensation avoids unnecessary reasoning.
- Improved installation and runtime reliability across Windows, macOS, Conda, Qoder, Goose, OpenCode, Antigravity, Codex, and TeamBrain. Fixes include launcher self-recursion and working-directory handling, stale temporary-directory cleanup, actionable authentication and missing-runtime errors, and correct host hook registration.
- Added optional cross-project context with `CLAUDE_MEM_CONTEXT_PROJECTS=all`, corrected folder context ordering and glob matching, expired orphaned summary spool entries, and improved effective-data-directory log lookup and cloud authentication telemetry.

Validation and delivery identities are recorded separately in the release receipt after the final builds, deployment, and package checks complete.

name: supervision-0.31.1
body:
# v0.31.1 — Recall that matches COCO, boxes that don't overflow

A bug-fix release: recall scores now agree with COCO, and half-precision boxes stop overflowing.

- **`MeanAverageRecall`** skips crowd regions and matches predictions in confidence order, like `pycocotools`.
- COCO segmentations loaded without an `area` field no longer make mAP return `-1`.
- `float16` boxes keep finite areas, and mAP and `with_nmm` stop overflowing on narrow coordinate types.
- Mask and halo annotators draw on grayscale scenes, and vertex annotators accept `(x, y, z)` points.
- Without OpenCV, ellipses and thick circles render like OpenCV 5, and grayscale images save correctly.

Drop-in upgrade, no code changes. mAR values can move: up on COCO data with crowd annotations, and in either direction where confidence order now decides which prediction claims a target.

## ✨ Spotlights / highlights

### Recall that matches COCO

`sv.metrics.MeanAverageRecall` used to count COCO crowd regions as missed objects and to pair predictions with the highest-IoU target first. It now leaves out targets with `data["iscrowd"]` or `data["ignore"]` set, the same rule `MeanAveragePrecision` uses. It also matches predictions in descending confidence order with COCO's tie rule, and counts an oriented-box IoU of exactly 0.55, 0.6, 0.8 or 0.85 as a match at that threshold. One target, one crowd target and a perfect prediction now score 1.0 instead of 0.5. (#2750, #2758, #2752)

```python
import numpy as np
import supervision as sv
from supervision.metrics import MeanAverageRecall

targets = sv.Detections(
    xyxy=np.array([[0, 0, 10, 10], [20, 20, 30, 30]], dtype=float),
    class_id=np.array([0, 0]),
    data={"iscrowd": np.array([0, 1])},
)
predictions = sv.Detections(
    xyxy=np.array([[0, 0, 10, 10]], dtype=float),
    class_id=np.array([0]),
    confidence=np.array([0.9]),
)
MeanAverageRecall().update(predictions, targets).compute().mAR_at_100  # 1.0
```

### Half-precision boxes that stay finite

A 256×256 box in `float16` has an area of 65,536, which is past `float16`'s maximum, so `Detections.box_area` returned `inf` and area filters dropped it. Box areas of `float16` detections are now computed and returned in `float32`, and `MeanAveragePrecision` and `with_nmm` no longer overflow on `float16` or narrow integer coordinates either. COCO segmentations loaded with masks but without an `area` field now get it from the decoded mask, so those targets stay in their size bucket instead of turning mAP into `-1`. (#2764, #2743, #2753, #2763)

```python
import numpy as np
import supervision as sv

detections = sv.Detections(
    xyxy=np.array([[0, 0, 256, 256], [0, 0, 0.01, 0.01]], dtype=np.float16)
)
detections.box_area  # array([6.5536000e+04, 1.0004273e-04], dtype=float32)
```

### Grayscale scenes and 3D keypoints in annotators

`sv.MaskAnnotator` and `sv.HaloAnnotator` raised `ValueError` on single-channel images. They now accept `(H, W)`, `(H, W, 1)` and Pillow `"L"` scenes, painting the gray value OpenCV would write for the same color. `VertexAnnotator` and the vertex-ellipse annotators draw `(x, y, z)` keypoints from their x and y, where they used to fail on tuple unpacking. (#2755, #2759)

```python
import numpy as np
import supervision as sv

scene = np.zeros((100, 100), dtype=np.uint8)
mask = np.zeros((1, 100, 100), dtype=bool)
mask[0, 20:60, 20:60] = True
detections = sv.Detections(
    xyxy=np.array([[20, 20, 60, 60]], dtype=float), mask=mask, class_id=np.array([0])
)
sv.MaskAnnotator().annotate(scene.copy(), detections).shape  # (100, 100)

key_points = sv.KeyPoints(xy=np.array([[[10, 10, 0.5], [50, 50, 1.0]]], dtype=np.float32))
sv.VertexAnnotator().annotate(np.zeros((64, 64, 3), dtype=np.uint8), key_points)
```

### Drawing without OpenCV, closer to OpenCV

The NumPy fallback used when OpenCV is not installed now ports OpenCV's ellipse rasterization, and thick circle outlines are centred on the radius instead of shrinking inward by half their thickness. Both match OpenCV 5.0 pixel for pixel in the reference tests. Without OpenCV, this changes the pixels drawn by `EllipseAnnotator`, `RoundBoxAnnotator`, the vertex-ellipse keypoint annotators, `CircleAnnotator` and `DotAnnotator` outlines. Image writing now accepts `(H, W, 1)` grayscale arrays and saves BGRA images as JPEG, and video reading handles files whose audio stream comes before the video stream. (#2740, #2765, #2754, #2746)

## 🔄 Migration guide

No migration required for this release.

## 📝 Notable changes

### 🔧 Fixed

**`MeanAverageRecall` and COCO**

- `sv.metrics.MeanAverageRecall` counted COCO crowd and ignored targets as missed objects and paired predictions by highest IoU first; it now skips those targets and matches in descending confidence order with COCO's last-target tie rule, as COCO does. (#2750, #2758)
- Oriented-box `MeanAverageRecall`, `Precision`, `Recall` and `F1Score` missed matches whose IoU was exactly 0.55, 0.6, 0.8 or 0.85, because the IoU was `float64` and the thresholds `float32`. (#2752)

**Overflow-safe boxes**

- `Detections.box_area` and box-based `Detections.area` overflowed to infinity for ordinary `float16` boxes; they now compute and return `float32`. (#2764)
- `sv.metrics.MeanAveragePrecision` overflowed box extents and areas for `float16` or narrow integer coordinates, so perfect large boxes scored `-1` or landed in the wrong size bucket. (#2743)
- `sv.Detections.with_nmm` overflowed its area-weighted confidence for `float16` boxes and, at extreme coordinates, for integer and `float32` boxes. (#2753)
- COCO loading with masks left segmented annotations without an `area` field with a `NaN` area, which pushed them out of every mAP size bucket; the area now comes from the decoded mask. (#2763)

**Masks and polygons**

- `resize_masks` returned an empty array when downscaling very narrow masks; it now keeps at least one pixel per axis. (#2762)
- `sv.filter_polygons_by_area` and `sv.polygon_to_xyxy` raised `ValueError` on empty polygons; they now treat them as zero area and an all-zero box. (#2761)

**Annotators**

- `sv.MaskAnnotator` and `sv.HaloAnnotator` raised `ValueError` on grayscale scenes. (#2755)
- `VertexAnnotator` and the vertex-ellipse annotators raised a tuple-unpacking error on three-coordinate keypoints; they now draw from x and y. (#2759)
- `sv.MaskAnnotator` widened its blend region to the boxes of all-empty masks, including `CompactMask`, copying and blending outside the foreground. (#2741)

**Without OpenCV**

- The fallback `ellipse` painted different pixels from OpenCV for thick strokes, fills and arcs; it now ports OpenCV's rasterization. (#2740)
- The fallback `circle` grew thick outlines inward from the bounding box, shrinking them by half their thickness; they are now centred on the radius. (#2765)
- Image writing rejected `(H, W, 1)` grayscale arrays and lost BGRA images saved as JPEG. (#2754)
- Video reading failed on files whose audio stream comes before the first video stream. (#2746)

## 🏆 Contributors

Welcome to our first-time contributors, Ghanashyam V Narayan and jorge!

- **NIKHIL** (@Nikhi00718) — fixed overflow in box areas, mAP and `with_nmm`, derived missing COCO areas, and fixed image writing and video reading without OpenCV.
- **Kaushik Reddy Lingireddy** (@Lingikaushikreddy) — made `MeanAverageRecall` skip crowd targets and match by confidence, and fixed oriented-box threshold matching.
- **peng xiang** (@px12811) — ported OpenCV's ellipse rasterization to the fallback and fixed mAR tie-breaking.
- **A Aswanth Raj** (@aswanth-07) — fixed three-coordinate keypoint drawing and narrow-mask resizing.
- **Mohammad Hijjawi** (@MohammadHijjawi97) — made `MaskAnnotator` and `HaloAnnotator` work on grayscale scenes.
- **kevin** (@kevin9327) — centred thick fallback circles on their radius.
- **Ghanashyam V Narayan** (@ghanashyam03) — made the polygon helpers accept empty polygons.
- **jorge** (@jorge-asenjo) — kept empty compact masks out of the mask blend region.
- **Jirka Borovec** (@Borda) — prepared the release.

______________________________________________________________________

**Full changelog**: <https://github.com/roboflow/supervision/compare/0.31.0...0.31.1>
