name: graphify 0.9.93
body:
Twenty-two community pull requests. Extraction: a reference to a Kotlin type alias, C# delegate, Swift macro, Dart typedef, Python module function or Rust sibling-module `use` now resolves to its real declaration instead of minting a sourceless stub; Metal/CUDA GPU qualifiers no longer mint god nodes; `extern "C"` headers route to the C++ extractor; an extensionless script with a versioned-interpreter shebang is classified; and Obsidian vault-relative wikilinks resolve. Plus a credential-redaction pass on rationale labels, a node-confidence fold, a truncated-reply label decode, a `.graphifyrc` BOM fix, a GraphML multigraph export fix, two-repo file disambiguation in explain and path, a PDF-read warning, no skill writes on `--version`/`--help`, two PR-tooling fixes (slashed default branch, legacy CI statuses), and a skill partly-read-file recovery so a long file a subagent only skimmed is retried on the next `--update` instead of silently kept half-read. The AST cache schema is bumped, so the first build after upgrading re-extracts.

- Fix: **Kotlin** a `typealias` declaration is extracted, so a field or parameter typed as the alias resolves to it instead of minting a sourceless cross-file stub (#4553, #4557, thanks @rajatnagda45).
- Fix: **C#** a `delegate` declaration is extracted, so references resolve to it instead of a sourceless stub; built-in `Func<>`/`Action<>` stay external (#4552, #4556, thanks @rajatnagda45).
- Fix: **Swift** `macro` declarations are extracted and a freestanding `#macro(...)` call resolves to the declaration; an unknown or standard-library macro stays unresolved rather than minting a stub (#4551, #4555, thanks @rajatnagda45).
- Fix: **Rust** a `use` rooted at a sibling `mod` (for example `use item::Thing;`) now reaches its declaration, while an external `use serde::...` still does not hijack a same-named local type (#4564, #4567, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah; reported by @almothafar-maf).
- Fix: **build** a node's drifted or legacy confidence is folded onto the enum the same way edges and hyperedges already are, so a node no longer reaches graph.json with an unnormalized confidence (#4529, #4531, thanks @rudycelekli; reported by @grazenN).
- Fix: **llm** community labels salvaged from a truncated reply are JSON-decoded, so an escaped label (`\"`, `\n`, `\uXXXX`, surrogate pairs) is no longer kept with literal backslash escapes (#4537, thanks @rudycelekli).
- Fix: **rcfile** `.graphifyrc` is read as utf-8-sig, so a file saved with a UTF-8 BOM no longer drops its first key (#4538, thanks @rudycelekli).
- Fix: **Dart** a `typedef` is extracted as a type alias on its own line, including the legacy `typedef R name(args)` form, instead of a bogus variable of type `typedef`; a field or parameter typed by the alias resolves to it rather than minting a sourceless `typedef` stub (#4582, thanks @madhusudanpatnaik).
- Fix: **Python** a `module.func()` call resolves to the module child named exactly `func`, even when a same-key sibling (for example a `FuncSchema` class beside a `func_schema` function) previously made the lookup ambiguous and dropped the edge; it never binds to a same-named child of an unrelated module (#4577, thanks @madhusudanpatnaik).
- Fix: **C++** Metal and CUDA GPU address/execution-space qualifiers (`kernel`, `device`, `constant`, `__global__`, `__device__`, ...) in a `.metal`/`.cu` file no longer mint sourceless god nodes; the kernel function still extracts and a `<<<...>>>` launch still resolves (#4550, #4554, thanks @rajatnagda45).
- Fix: **extract** a `.h` header containing `extern "C"` is routed to the C++ extractor, so a C-API header the C grammar rejects extracts its symbols instead of nothing (#4526, thanks @bekzodibragimov2004-design).
- Fix: **extract** credential-shaped text (API keys, tokens, Bearer tokens, private-key headers, `user:pass@` URLs) in a comment or docstring that becomes a rationale label is redacted before it reaches graph.json, the viz or exports; ordinary identifiers such as git SHAs and UUIDs are left intact (#4566, thanks @0xkaushik-ai).
- Fix: **export** GraphML export of a graph loaded as a MultiGraph (a graph with parallel edges, after #4500) no longer crashes with an empty output; parallel edges are written with distinct keys and round-trip through `read_graphml` (#4536, thanks @rudycelekli).
- Fix: **prs** the default branch is derived by stripping only the `refs/remotes/origin/` prefix, so a branch name that contains a slash (for example `release/2.x`) is kept whole and PRs against it are no longer all dropped as wrong-base (#4534, thanks @rudycelekli).
- Fix: **prs** CI classification now reads legacy commit-status `StatusContext` state in addition to check-run conclusions, so a PR whose only signal is an external status (Jenkins, CircleCI) is classified correctly, with a failing status taking precedence (#4533, thanks @rudycelekli).
- Fix: **detect** an extensionless script whose shebang names a versioned interpreter (`#!/usr/bin/env python3.11`, `#!/bin/bash5`, `ruby3.2`, ...) is now classified to its language instead of being skipped (#4535, thanks @rudycelekli).
- Fix: **detect** when a PDF cannot be read (corrupt, encrypted, or a missing optional dependency) graphify prints a one-time warning naming the file instead of silently returning empty text, so a failed read is distinguishable from a text-less PDF (#4527, thanks @rudycelekli; reported by @grazenN).
- Fix: **markdown** an Obsidian `[[wikilink]]` whose target begins with one of the scan root's own folder names (a vault-relative path) now resolves to the real page instead of a ghost node, restoring intra-vault connectivity (#4559, thanks @bercedev; reported by @CryptoRMac4).
- Fix: **explain / path** two same-path files from different repos in a merged graph are kept distinct: an ambiguous name names each repo and the retry hint points at the full node id, instead of conflating them as one file (#4512, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah; reported by @kaka-in-home).
- Fix: **cli** `graphify --version` and `--help` no longer rewrite or back up an installed skill file; only a real command refreshes skills (the staleness warning still prints) (#4545, thanks @bercedev; reported by @EmanuelFaria).
- Fix: **query** a bare name that is the exact name of several nodes (for example a `.nonce()` method in two files) is refused with the candidates listed and the ambiguous exit code, matching `explain` and `path`; a keyword that only prefix- or substring-matches labels still runs a normal search (#4511, #4517, thanks @shivampal46011; reported by @kaka-in-home).
- Fix: **skill** a long file a subagent only partly read is no longer a silent, permanent loss. On the skill extraction path each chunk now self-reports the lines it covered; a file whose reported coverage falls short of its real length is written to `.graphify_partial.txt`, cached as partial (which the loader treats as a miss) and left unstamped in the manifest, so the next `--update` re-dispatches it and replace-on-re-extract swaps the half-read node set for a complete one. This mirrors the library path's truncated-reply recovery (#933, #1950); the already-extracted nodes are kept, and a file no subagent reported is not falsely flagged (#3987, #2225, thanks @nothariharan; reported by @Ryanm218).

## [2.12.4] ### Bug Fixes - [`136a28eaa`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/136a28eaa879e8aa706f9b2e05a050c46dcc1f4f) ([#16305](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16305) by [@Chaosnico9000](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../Chaosnico9000)) Skip the `--target` validation when `rustup target list` fails, e.g. when `rustup` is on `PATH` but has no toolchain installed, instead of rejecting every target as missing. - [`52081e04a`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/52081e04a0309620d3eb8121e5ca9b66312f9857) ([#16333](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16333) by [@amrbashir](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../amrbashir)) Rename the misspelled `choowHowToInstall` NSIS language string to `chooseHowToInstall`. A custom language file in `bundle.windows.nsis.customLanguageFiles` that only defines the old name keeps working for now, but users should migrate to the new name. ### Dependencies - Upgraded to `tauri-macos-sign@2.4.3` - Upgraded to `tauri-bundler@2.10.4` - [`4a6f51251`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/4a6f512519286ff9862b2e86c67ef39f4562aee5) ([#16317](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16317) by [@lazerg](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../lazerg)) Updated `zip` to v9 to fix RUSTSEC-2026-0367, RUSTSEC-2026-0368 and RUSTSEC-2026-0369.

## [2.10.4] ### Bug Fixes - [`52081e04a`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/52081e04a0309620d3eb8121e5ca9b66312f9857) ([#16333](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16333) by [@amrbashir](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../amrbashir)) Rename the misspelled `choowHowToInstall` NSIS language string to `chooseHowToInstall`. A custom language file in `bundle.windows.nsis.customLanguageFiles` that only defines the old name keeps working for now, but users should migrate to the new name. - [`1a02ec364`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/1a02ec36401de1f5eafe99fd6a8b45d3a1356993) ([#16330](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16330) by [@lazerg](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../lazerg)) Quote the executable path in the file association `shell\open\command` and `DefaultIcon` registry values written by the NSIS installer, so opening an associated file no longer depends on how Windows splits an unquoted path that contains spaces. - [`46b3de424`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/46b3de4243ea282cee190a2505a0dde7dad1bc14) ([#16335](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16335) by [@amrbashir](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../amrbashir)) Fixed the German NSIS installer defining the `older` and `unknown` strings under translated identifiers (`älter` and `unbekannt`), which made makensis emit `warning 6040: LangString "older" is not set in language table of language German` and left the version kind blank in the "An $R4 version of ... is installed on your system" prompt. - [`46b3de424`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/46b3de4243ea282cee190a2505a0dde7dad1bc14) ([#16335](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16335) by [@amrbashir](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../amrbashir)) Fixed malformed tokens in the Italian and Swedish NSIS language files. - [`c0e3dbd91`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/c0e3dbd91def4b2c39fc7cca03f0b86407e9d584) ([#16254](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16254) by [@kihyun1998](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../kihyun1998)) Fix NSIS installers not blocking downgrades over a newer installation made by the MSI installer in silent (`/S`), passive (`/P`) and update (`/UPDATE`) modes when `bundle.windows.allowDowngrades` is `false`. ### Dependencies - Upgraded to `tauri-macos-sign@2.4.3` - [`4a6f51251`](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/commit/4a6f512519286ff9862b2e86c67ef39f4562aee5) ([#16317](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/pull/16317) by [@lazerg](https://www.github.com/tauri-apps/tauri/../../lazerg)) Updated `zip` to v9 to fix RUSTSEC-2026-0367, RUSTSEC-2026-0368 and RUSTSEC-2026-0369.

body:
## Cua Spaces 0.12.1

### Better
- **A failed payment is now explained.** If a card payment fails, Cua Spaces tells you and says what to do next, instead of leaving your plan looking unchanged.
- **Plain plan errors.** When something is blocked by your plan, such as sharing by email or using more hours than it includes, the message now says so in simple words and points to the plan page.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/trycua/cua/compare/cua-spaces-v0.12.0...cua-spaces-v0.12.1)

name: Cua Spaces v0.12.0
body:
## Cua Spaces 0.12.0

### New
- **Your language.** Cua Spaces now speaks five more languages. Pick one under Settings > Language.
- **Problems show up on the Machines page.** Each computer lists its own issues, found by its health checks, so you can see what's wrong without opening a terminal. `cua doctor --machine` prints the same checks.
- **Clear plan dates.** After you cancel, the app shows "Teams until <date>" and a Resume plan button.

### Better
- Sharing, Settings, the viewer and teleport messages are all translated.
- Cua Driver is more reliable on Windows and Linux when clicking, dragging and typing into the right window.

### Security
- Cua now refuses certificates from two compromised eMudhra intermediates in every client.

name: cua-driver-rs: v0.38.0
body:
# Cua Driver 0.38.0

## Summary

This release adds 1 features and includes 25 fixes.

## Features

- publish cua-sdk and the proto contract so you can build your own harness (CUA-1902). ([#5532](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5532))

## Fixes

- accept the GNOME helper only from the session's Shell. ([#5496](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5496)) Thanks @only21mil.
- restrict Windows launch candidates to the receipt process family. ([#5561](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5561)) reported by @loonghao.
- let launch_app take the .app path that list_apps reports. ([#5525](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5525)) Thanks @tlq5l.
- refuse unsafe GNOME 50+ helper startup. ([#5565](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5565)) reported by @1111david.
- avoid unsafe zero-delivery retry advice for macOS web typing. ([#5560](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5560)) reported by @howardxie-dev.
- scale Windows foreground scroll targets from the screenshot context. ([#5567](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5567)) Thanks @omoi0kane.
- stop macOS EINVAL flake in daemon client and settle capture/menu tests on conditions. ([#5558](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5558))
- keep an ended session's master pointer until its popup menu closes. ([#5254](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5254)) Thanks @CMGS.
- discover native Wayland windows in desktop snapshots. ([#5368](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5368)) Thanks @ceckert.
- deliver window-only foreground hotkeys through the HID activation guard. ([#5522](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5522)) Thanks @abonneth.
- report unknown tools accurately. ([#5579](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5579))
- handle Add-Type failure on non-ASCII locales. ([#5581](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5581))
- Windows list_windows omits the driver's own overlay windows. ([#5566](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5566)) Thanks @CMGS.
- fix Windows selected-browser launch guidance. ([#5583](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5583))
- keep GNOME element actions inside the requested window. ([#5585](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5585)) Thanks @only21mil.
- report Windows tree completeness. ([#5582](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5582)) Thanks @ethanblake4.
- suspend the target GUI thread while posting a Windows click. ([#5584](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5584))
- classify DOM click effects with readback. ([#5586](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5586))
- recover rootless XWayland browser identities. ([#5597](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5597))
- retry unverified macOS window prefetches. ([#5605](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5605))
- track cursor placement explicitly. ([#5603](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5603))
- undo the GTK4 CSD inset before at-point ownership checks. ([#5610](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5610)) Thanks @ZIXT233.
- verify foreground Document text insertion. ([#5587](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5587)) Thanks @wszkxlllll.
- never send a Windows foreground drag to the window covering the target. ([#5616](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5616)) Thanks @SunkenInTime.
- distrust the compromised eMudhra intermediates in every Cua client (CUA-1948). ([#5622](https://github.com/trycua/cua/pull/5622))

## Contributors

Thanks to @1111david, @abonneth, @ceckert, @CMGS, @ethanblake4, @howardxie-dev, @loonghao, @omoi0kane, @only21mil, @SunkenInTime, @tlq5l, @wszkxlllll, @ZIXT233 for contributing to this release.

## Install

macOS and Linux:

```bash
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"
```

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex
```

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds,
and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and
uninstaller scripts.

## Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest”
pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua
Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on
their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned
`cua-driver-rs-v*` releases directly.
